- Help customers identify opportunities to reduce emissions using Flexport’s shipment data.
- Make lower-emission choices easier to understand and act on within existing workflows.
- Develop products that help customers understand the wider environmental footprint of their supply chains, beyond freight.
- Deliver useful improvements incrementally, balancing speed, scope, maintainability, and data accuracy.
- Coordinate with other engineering teams when your work depends on shared systems, integrations, or expertise.
- Measure whether what you ship solves the underlying problem, and use that evidence to decide what comes next.
You Should Have
- 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong engineering foundation and experience delivering production software.
- A track record of working independently: you can bring structure to an unclear problem, set priorities, unblock yourself, and follow through without a detailed specification or constant direction.
- Strong product judgment: you understand user needs, identify what is worth building, and make thoughtful tradeoffs between impact and effort.
- Experience working closely with business stakeholders: you ask good questions, explain technical choices in plain language, and constructively challenge ideas when needed.
- The ability to own features across the stack, including user interfaces, backend services, and data integrations.
- A love of simple, well-tested code that is easy to extend and hard to break.
- Comfort taking responsibility for the reliability and maintenance of what you build.
- A bias for action, combined with the judgment to recognize when you need input or help.
- An aptitude for learning quickly, including unfamiliar business domains and technologies.
Nice to Have
- A personal motivation to work on climate and environmental challenges.
- Experience in climate technology, emissions accounting, logistics, or supply chain software.
- Experience building products in a startup or another small team with broad ownership.
- Experience turning complex data into customer-facing insights and decision tools.
Prior climate experience is a plus; curiosity and the ability to learn the domain matter more.
How We Work

About MotherDuck
Don’t let the quirky name fool you: At MotherDuck, we’re on a mission to make data warehousing fun, frictionless, and ducking awesome for developers and data practitioners building blazing fast internal and customer-facing analytics experiences. We're building a cloud-hosted version of DuckDB, working hand-in-hand with the creators of the fastest-growing and fastest-improving query engine on the planet. Unlike other databases, MotherDuck was architected to unify local development with cloud operations to bridge the gap between software and data engineering workflows. Our team is a mix of thoughtful, passionate, and empathetic data industry veterans.
What you will do
The Database team is the bridge between DuckDB and the cloud. We own the core server and client extension logic that lets DuckDB run seamlessly, whether it's local or in the cloud, and we work in C++ right alongside the DuckDB codebase itself. Our mission is to push the boundaries of embedded database performance, distributed execution, and user experience, all while staying closely connected to DuckDB Labs (the team behind DuckDB) to align on APIs and shape what's next.
Day to day, we drive major projects in dual execution, resource assignment, and system reliability, while also handling incoming issues and lending our DuckDB expertise to other teams. We collaborate closely across MotherDuck and with the wider DuckDB community, making sure people get the best of both local and cloud worlds. It's a small, high-agency team with big ambitions... the kind of place where engineers own impactful projects, share what they learn, and help shape how modern analytics gets built.
This role is ideally based in Amsterdam or Berlin, but we are also open to great candidates remotely in Europe.
Key Responsibilities:
- Own major projects in our dual execution stack, so DuckDB can process queries seamlessly whether they're running locally or in the cloud.
- Help build a cloud platform that dynamically assigns resources, so DuckDB stays efficient whether someone's running a tiny workload or pushing our biggest, highest-memory instances.
- Lead cross-functional work with our frontend, platform, and infrastructure teams to keep the user experience coherent end to end.
- Push the state of the art in embedded database performance, distributed execution, and DuckDB internals.
- Deepen your DuckDB expertise and share it with the rest of the company through mentorship and documentation.
- Work directly with our support team to debug issues, learn from real usage patterns, and prioritize the improvements that matter most.
- Improve systems holistically... spotting architectural challenges early and clearing bottlenecks before they become problems.
- Mentor teammates and help raise the bar for engineering practices across the team.
- Work closely with DuckDB Labs (which grew out of the Database Architectures group at CWI, where vectorized execution and DuckDB were born) to help align on APIs and shape where DuckDB goes next.
What you bring
- You've built and shipped complex backend systems, and you know what great looks like.
- You're fluent in a backend language like C++, Rust, Java, or similar systems languages, and you're comfortable working close to the metal. (C++ and Rust are the biggest plus here, and we love a great Java engineer too.)
- A good foundation in query engines, execution plans, indexing, and performance optimization techniques.
- Hands-on experience with DuckDB is a huge plus, no matter what level you're coming in at.
- You've worked with cloud infrastructure, networking, and building low-latency distributed systems.
- You can scope and lead projects that span multiple collaborators and cross-functional dependencies.
- You take pride in clear thinking, careful design, and thoughtful tradeoffs.
- You're comfortable mentoring peers and helping build a collaborative, high-agency environment.
- You enjoy engaging with the wider community, whether that's open-source conversations or working directly with DuckDB Labs.
What we provide
- The opportunity to participate and contribute to DuckDB, one of most popular modern open source analytical databases.
- Competitive salary and stock options so you have a stake in our flock’s success.
- Flexible time off – take the time you need to recharge, explore, or just have a lazy day by the pond.
- A good pension plan
- Legendary company events – we bring the whole flock together once a year for unforgettable team gatherings a year to keep our bonds strong.
- Hybrid work environment – Spend three days a week in the office collaborating with the flock, and work from wherever you’re most productive the rest of the time—whether that’s your home office, a coffee shop, or a peaceful lakeside retreat. jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.description:
Who We Are
Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital.
The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page.
Role summary
Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong.
The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers.
You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure.
What you will own
Core security leadership (about half)
- Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on.
- Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises.
- Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline.
- Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data.
- Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in.
- Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and leaders.
- Policy, compliance and trust. Write and enforce policies people actually follow. Prepare the company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 with Legal & Compliance. Own the public security and trust story, including the trust page on our products.
- Team leadership. Manage and develop our security engineers, decide what we build in-house versus outsource, and grow the team only where automation cannot do the job.
- Member scam awareness. Supply the security content behind scam-awareness messaging to members, working with Community, Support and Marketing. Legal approves the wording.
AI-driven security (about half)
- Full attack-surface map. Build and maintain a living inventory of everything we run: internal apps, cloud, code repos, and every SaaS tool and integration (CRM, telephony, community, payments, data providers). Know what connects to what, who has access, and what is logged.
- Agentic security harness. Design and run AI-driven systems that approach 100% coverage: automated code and dependency review, continuous configuration and access audits, and vendor documentation review. Humans set direction and make the judgment calls; agents do the exhaustive work.
- AI-driven detection and logging. Own the security stack (SIEM, Rapid7; endpoint protection; email security; identity and device management), make sure every critical system sends usable logs, and use AI to triage alerts and hunt across them.
- Secure AI and vibe-coding standards. Set the rules for how teams build with AI: what can ship, what data AI tools may touch, and the review path before anything with customer data goes live.
- AI agent security. As more of the company runs on agents and automations, secure them: scoped credentials and tool permissions, prompt-injection defense, data exposure, and monitoring and guardrails for agents in production. Review high-risk agents before launch, including our own security agents.
Scope
This role protects our company, our platforms, our data and our brands. For members' personal wallets and accounts outside our platforms, our role is education: helping members recognize and avoid scams.
Requirements
What you will bring
Must have
- 10+ years in security, including 3+ years leading a security function as CISO, Head of Security or equivalent at a company of 100+ people.
- Has led live-incident response, not just tabletop exercises, including briefing executives during the incident.
- Has built or rebuilt a security program from an early stage: strategy, policy, tooling, training and incident response.
- AI-native operator. Uses AI agents daily to do the work: writing detections, reviewing code and configs, reading vendor documentation, drafting policy. Can show us the harnesses, workflows or automations you have built, and knows where AI stops and human judgment has to take over.
- Deep, current knowledge of AI-specific risks: prompt injection, over-scoped agent permissions, credential and data exposure through AI tools, and insecure AI-generated code.
- Hands-on with cloud security (AWS preferred), identity and access management, SIEM, endpoint protection and email security.
- Writes code: scripts, tooling and automation, not only vendor UIs.
- Experience in crypto, fintech or another high-fraud industry, and deep knowledge of phishing, social engineering and impersonation attacks.
- Can read the fine print: thorough with documentation, contracts and vendor security terms, and documents everything so nothing slips through.
- Briefs executives in plain language, trains non-technical staff, and writes policy people follow.
- Player-coach: comfortable spending about half your time hands-on while leading a small, fully remote team across many time zones.
Nice to have
- Has prepared a company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001.
- Has secured or evaluated AI agents and LLM-based tools in production.
- Has run a third-party risk program covering financial data aggregators or similar providers.
- Has run a brand protection or takedown program.
- Experience with customer-facing security features such as account-takeover defense.
- Experience with risk quantification (FAIR or similar) and presenting to a board.
- Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, GCIH or OSCP.
Benefits
What We Offer
- Competitive compensation package
- Independent Contractor opportunity
- Fully remote, globally distributed team
- Team offsites (Dubai, Costa Rica, etc.)
- Collaborative, forward-thinking culture that values innovation and results

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Search
jobs.description:
About Staffbase
We inspire people to achieve great things together. Our mission is to help organizations unlock the power of inspirational communication with the first AI-native Employee Experience Platform. Our industry-leading and award-winning agentic AI communications channels - intranet, employee app and email solutions - create engaging experiences that connect and empower employees.
Headquartered in Chemnitz, Germany and New York City, with offices in Berlin, London, Sydney, Tokyo, Prague, and Minneapolis–St. Paul, our diverse team of 550+ employees supports 1,500+ customers—reaching over 14 million employees—in transforming their employee experience.
We are proud to be a Unicorn company—privately valued at over $1 billion—demonstrating strong growth, innovation, and lasting impact in our industry. Together, we’re shaping the future of workplace communication.
As a Staff Engineer on the Search team, you'll take on one of our most important platform challenges: making every employee able to find what they need, and get a trustworthy answer, across Staffbase and the tools around it. Today search spans people, posts, pages, files and connected integrations, and it increasingly feeds AI-generated answers. You'll define how retrieval, ranking and grounded answers work at that scale.
Your north star is a search platform that finds the right thing, fast, for the right person. It must respect permissions on every query, work in every language our customers use, and give answers that cite their sources. You'll build the core, set the quality bar, and decide where we use proven techniques and where we experiment, all on a mature, multi-tenant platform.
This is a role for someone who wants to drive, not just deliver. You'll shape the direction of an open-ended problem, and you'll measure your work with real relevance data, not gut feeling.
Our tech stack includes Kotlin, Java, OpenSearch/Elasticsearch, MongoDB, React, TypeScript, Terraform, Docker and Playwright, plus LLM and embedding services for retrieval, reranking and summarisation.
The Team
The Search team sits at the heart of how employees find information at Staffbase. We own the full path from query to result: indexing and embeddings, hybrid keyword and semantic retrieval, ranking and reranking, typeahead, and the AI summaries that answer questions with citations. Search is also a core source of knowledge for Navigator, our AI assistant, and the main way it grounds its answers in company content.
That means two big things. First, we make results relevant: understanding the query, retrieving the right candidates, ranking them well, and doing it in the user's language. Second, we make search safe and fast: every result respects the user's access rights, every tenant stays isolated, and the fast path stays fast. We don't ship relevance changes on a hunch. We run offline evaluations, golden query sets and online signals, and we change one thing at a time.
Our environment
- Working with skilled and similar-minded professionals in a team that values diversity and inclusivity
- We aim to create a flexible and agile work environment that promotes the well-being and work-life balance of our employees
- We are enthusiastic about technology and committed to using it to improve the world
- We follow the "You build it, you run it" approach and take pride in it
What you'll be doing
- Define and drive the search and retrieval strategy: hybrid (BM25 + vector) retrieval, reranking, query understanding and rewriting, chunking and embedding choices
- Build and evolve the core ingestion and query pipeline, from sync and indexing to ranked results and AI summaries with citations
- Own search quality: build evaluation tooling and golden sets (including unanswerable and permission-varying queries), define relevance metrics, and turn them into decisions
- Protect the non-negotiables at scale: permission-aware retrieval, tenant isolation, multilingual handling, and graceful degradation when a dependency is slow or down
- Balance latency, quality and cost, for example what runs on the fast path versus what is allowed on the slow path
- Make search observable: tracing, relevance dashboards, and a clear way to debug why a result did or did not appear
- Lead technical strategy and architecture, and document key decisions so others can build on them
- Take ownership of major technical decisions, proactively addressing bottlenecks and ensuring product quality
- Work with Product and Design to turn user problems into measurable search improvements
- Contribute to technical roadmaps with engineering leadership, and coordinate with teams that feed or consume search (content, integrations, Navigator)
- Mentor and guide engineers through code reviews, design discussions and experiment reviews
- Foster a culture of ownership, technical excellence and continuous improvement with teams that feed or consume search (content, integrations, Navigator)
What you need to be successful
- Proven track record as a Staff Engineer or Technical Lead with strong leadership and problem-solving skills
- Proven experience building production search or retrieval systems (OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Solr or similar), including relevance tuning, analyzers, and index design
- Hands-on experience with modern retrieval: vector/kNN search, hybrid fusion (e.g. RRF), cross-encoder reranking, chunking and embeddings; ideally RAG or LLM-grounded answers
- A measurement mindset: you've built or used relevance evaluation (recall, MRR, nDCG, golden sets, LLM-as-judge with human checks) and can tell a real improvement from noise
- Strong understanding of multi-tenant architecture and permission-aware retrieval, with good judgment on security and isolation in search
- Experience with latency-sensitive systems: budgets, timeouts, caching, fallbacks and degradation
- Extensive experience with Kotlin/Java (or Go) on the backend; comfortable with React/TypeScript on the frontend
- Knowledge of architecture and design patterns, and the judgment to make trade-offs and weigh their long-term impact
- Strong communication skills, able to explain relevance and ranking trade-offs to technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Experience working with Product and Design leaders to deliver customer value in an Agile environment
- Passion for building high-quality software
- Passion for diversity and inclusion, and the ability to foster a culture where everyone's voice is heard
Nice to have
- Multilingual search (analyzers, language detection, cross-language retrieval)
- Query understanding: rewriting, expansion, typeahead and spell correction
- Prompt-injection and data-poisoning awareness in RAG systems
- Experience with LLM observability and evaluation tooling
What you'll get
- Competitive Compensation - we offer attractive salary packages including LTIP (unit-based Long Term Incentive Plan)
- Flexibility - we offer flexible working time models and the option of hybrid work, and support this with a yearly flex work allowance of €1560
- Recharge - with 31 vacation days annually (incl. one floating holiday), plus pro rata fully paid Fridays off during August
- Support - we offer offering a company pension scheme
- Volunteers Day - you’ll get one day off per year for supporting a social project

This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI Engineer based in Germany.
We are looking for an experienced AI Engineer to build and deploy production-grade AI systems that address complex challenges across heavy industries, including utilities, manufacturing, logistics, and energy. You will play a key role in developing a next-generation industrial operating system, taking innovative products from concept to production. The role combines agentic AI, multimodal machine learning, industrial data integration, and full-stack engineering. You will work with real-world data from sensors, machines, and operational systems to deliver intelligent solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, and decision-making. This is a high-ownership opportunity in a fast-moving, zero-to-one product environment. You will help establish the foundations of an ambitious platform designed to transform industrial operations.
Accountabilities
You will design, build, and ship the core AI capabilities of an industrial intelligence platform, connecting advanced models with operational data, enterprise systems, and practical decision-making tools.
-
Develop and deploy agentic AI systems, including orchestration, tool use, state management, and human-in-the-loop workflows.
-
Build agent runtimes and orchestration frameworks supporting specialized agents for vision quality, predictive maintenance, and operations planning.
-
Design context assembly systems using industrial ontologies and memory, including tool dispatch, approval gates, tracing, and cost controls.
-
Develop multimodal data pipelines combining video processing, computer vision, and structured operational data.
-
Implement computer vision capabilities such as object detection, segmentation, and action recognition, using technologies such as YOLO and OpenCV.
-
Process industrial sensor data, including RTSP video, time-series telemetry, vibration, thermal data, and PLC/OPC-UA streams.
-
Build signal-processing and sensor-correlation workflows, including FFT feature extraction and cross-sensor analysis.
-
Design and contribute to industrial ontologies and knowledge graphs representing plants, assets, sensors, work orders, materials, and maintenance histories.
-
Develop memory systems for trace storage, playbooks, asset templates, and reusable failure-pattern libraries.
-
Build operational interfaces such as dashboards, evidence-based alerting workflows, replanning tools, and audit trails.
-
Develop integration connectors for ERP, CMMS, WMS, industrial historians, and PLC systems, ensuring data normalization and consistent schema mapping.
-
Deliver end-to-end solutions spanning data ingestion, model serving, backend services, and frontend interfaces.
-
Ensure production systems meet demanding requirements for reliability, latency, scalability, cost efficiency, and operational usability.
Requirements
The ideal candidate is an autonomous, hands-on AI engineer with experience taking complex systems from initial development to production, particularly in environments involving physical-world data and industrial operations.
-
At least 3 years of experience building and shipping production AI systems; 5+ years preferred.
-
Proven experience developing agentic AI products and production systems, including orchestration, tool integration, state management, and human oversight.
-
Experience as an early-stage engineer at a venture-backed startup, contributing to products and systems from zero to one.
-
Strong background in AI and machine learning applied to physical-world systems.
-
Experience working with large-scale industrial data, such as video streams, IoT devices, sensor telemetry, vibration, thermal data, or PLC/OPC-UA systems.
-
Hands-on experience building multimodal AI pipelines that combine computer vision with structured operational data.
-
Understanding of data ingestion, normalization, temporal alignment, data quality, and ground-truth challenges in real-world environments.
-
Experience with industrial ontologies, knowledge graphs, or structured context systems based on asset hierarchies and operational processes.
-
Experience integrating AI systems with enterprise and industrial platforms such as ERP, CMMS, WMS, historians, or PLC systems.
-
Strong software engineering skills across backend and frontend development, including Python and TypeScript.
-
Experience with production-oriented technologies such as FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React Native, and OpenCV.
-
A practical understanding of system reliability, failure modes, latency, cost management, and human interaction.
-
Ability to work autonomously, take ownership, and deliver in a fast-paced, high-intensity environment.
-
Strong motivation to solve complex industrial challenges through hands-on engineering and applied AI.
Benefits
-
Opportunity to help build a category-defining industrial operating system with the potential to shape manufacturing plants and industrial facilities over the next 10–20 years.
-
Exceptional employee equity package, with an equity pool described as twice the industry standard and an estimated value of more than $200,000 from day one.
-
Opportunity to work alongside an experienced team with backgrounds in enterprise technology, industrial robotics, autonomous driving, and academic research.
-
Exposure to complex, real-world industrial challenges and large volumes of underutilized sensor data.
-
Direct impact on operational efficiency, predictive maintenance, industrial reliability, and decision-making across major industries.
-
Opportunity to contribute to a zero-to-one product in an ambitious, innovation-driven environment.

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.
What you'll do
- Design, develop, and maintain embedded software that runs close to hardware on flight and ground systems.
- Implement real time software on Embedded Linux, RTOS, or bare metal platforms, with a focus on determinism, reliability, and performance.
- Develop and maintain low level drivers, interfaces, and middleware for sensors, actuators, and avionics hardware.
- Write high quality C and/or C++ code that meets the demands of safety critical, high performance systems.
- Work closely with electronics, avionics, and systems engineers to co-design hardware and software interfaces.
- Support integration, debugging, and testing on real hardware, including bring up, fault isolation, and performance tuning.
- Where useful, leverage model based design and code generation (e.g. MATLAB/Simulink) to accelerate development and reduce error.
- Contribute to FPGA adjacent development or VHDL based workflows where they interface with embedded software.
Who you are
- An senior embedded software engineer with 8+ years’ experience working close to hardware in aerospace, defence, or similarly demanding systems.
- Comfortable developing on Embedded Linux, RTOS, or bare-metal platforms, with a strong intuition for timing, determinism, and resource constraints.
- Fluent in C and/or C++, with a focus on correctness, clarity, and long-term maintainability.
- Someone who enjoys debugging on real hardware, not just in simulation or abstraction layers.
- Experienced collaborating tightly with electronics and avionics engineers, and shaping interfaces rather than just consuming them.
- Pragmatic about tools, open to model-based development where it accelerates delivery without obscuring behaviour.
- Curious about FPGA-adjacent workflows and comfortable interfacing with low-level logic when required.
- Motivated by building flight-critical software in a small team where your code directly affects system behaviour.
What we offer
- A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security.
- Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow.
- High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes.
- A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions.
- A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly.
- Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy.
Security and Eligibility Requirement
Due to the nature of the work we undertake, applicants must be a EU/Nato/German citizen, and be eligible for German Security Clearance.
At Hypersonica, every hire raises the bar. We are deliberately small, intensely capable, and deeply mission-driven. If this role feels like a strong fit, or if you believe you bring something exceptional that goes beyond the description, we encourage you to apply.
Hypersonica is an equal-opportunity employer and assesses candidates solely on merit, capability, and potential.
You can apply directly to this role or reach out to Nathan Sweeney, Head of Talent. We review every application and aim to respond to all candidates within two weeks, whether the answer is yes or no.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Engineer - Platform & Partner Experience
jobs.description:
We design Spotify's consumer experience — end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints — from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
Platform & Partner Experience (PPX) sits within the Experience Mission, shaping how Spotify shows up across devices, platforms, and partner ecosystems. We build the foundations that power seamless integrations — from smart speakers to cars to AI agents — while ensuring every interaction feels personal, reliable, and unmistakably Spotify.
As a Senior Staff Engineer, you'll advance how our systems power partner experiences at scale, tackling complex challenges that span teams, systems and organizational boundaries. You will work closely with platform, infrastructure, and product teams across the company to create shared foundations, streamline our architecture and unlock new experiences for our users and partners.
What You Will Do
- Lead the technical strategy, architecture, and development of systems that enable and enhance partner and platform experiences across devices and integrations
- Drive complex technical initiatives that span multiple studios or a full mission — particularly where coordination cost, architectural sprawl, or competing local optimizations are part of the problem

Who You Are

- You have a strong track record of technical leadership — influencing and shaping architecture decisions across teams, and driving organizational change in how software gets built

jobs.title: Langfuse - Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description:
Why Backend Engineering at Langfuse
Your work will have an outsized impact.
Langfuse ingests terabytes of AI tracing data per day. When a Fortune 50 company instruments their application with Langfuse, they hit the infrastructure you built. Everything you ship is open source and immediately visible.
The core of your role is making Langfuse fast and affordable at scale: owning the ingestion pipeline, optimizing ClickHouse data models and queries so dashboards load instantly, and building the backend abstractions that let product engineers ship data-heavy features without reinventing the plumbing each time.
You will also make sure Langfuse runs everywhere. You’ll operate Langfuse Cloud across multiple production environments, and make self-hosting effortless. You will support a single Docker Compose setup to enterprise-grade Helm chart deployment.
You won’t be solving these problems alone. Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the people who built the database you’re optimizing are one channel away. Few backend roles give you that kind of access to the internals of your core datastore.
You will grow at Langfuse by
- Own and optimize our ingestion pipeline: Langfuse ingests massive volumes of tracing data through a pipeline that flows from our API to ClickHouse. You'll work on throughput, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency at every stage of this pipeline.
- Make ClickHouse fast: our tracing data lives in ClickHouse. You'll design schemas, optimize merge strategies, tune batch inserts, write and review analytical queries that power dashboards and the UI. You'll become an expert on ClickHouse internals — and you'll have the ClickHouse database engineering team one channel away.
- Build new infrastructure-heavy features: things like LLM-as-a-Judge (where we post-process large volumes of ingested data asynchronously), alerting at scale, client-code execution, or batch dataset operations. Build the foundation and, if you like, dip your toes into the frontend for those.
- Test with real data in production: when evaluating a new ClickHouse schema, migration, or query optimization, you'll run load tests against production data to validate that changes actually improve things. We don't guess at performance. We prototype new table designs, run them in parallel on real traffic, and compare before committing.
- Scale for what's next: we're growing fast and new product directions like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale.
Learn more about our infrastructure
- From Zero to Scale: Langfuse's Infrastructure Evolution — deep dive into how we went from Postgres to ClickHouse
- Max talking infrastructure at ClickHouse OpenHouse Amsterdam — recording of our CTO walking through the architecture
- Architecture
What we're looking for
- Strong backend engineer who gets excited about database internals, query optimization, and distributed systems
- You get excited when working with a ton of data
- Experience with analytical databases, data pipelines, or high-throughput event processing. ClickHouse experience is a big plus but not required
- You organize yourself. You have strong opinions about what to build and how to ship it
- Comfortable reading and writing TypeScript (our backend) and SQL
- Interest in open source software and genuine enjoyment talking to users about their scaling challenges
- Thrives in a small, accountable team where your output is visible and matters
- CS or quantitative degree preferred
Bonus points:
- Experience with ClickHouse, other OLAP databases, or observability infrastructure
- Former founder
- Background in building data-intensive systems at scale
Perks
- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.
- Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.
- Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.
- Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.
- A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.
- Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.
Culture - We All Shape It
As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.
Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Abound
We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation.
And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch.
Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us.
About the role
We're looking for a Junior Software Engineer to join our engineering team in London. This is a hybrid role, with a minimum of three days a week in our London office. This is a great opportunity for someone early in their career who wants to grow quickly, work on real production systems, and learn how a high-growth fintech operates from the inside.
You'll work alongside experienced engineers who will support you through code reviews, pairing and mentorship. We maintain a culture of ownership, and we value engineers who are curious about the business and keen to work with stakeholders to improve processes and the customer experience.
There are opportunities across platform engineering, B2B customer integration, conversion optimisation and business process automation. You'll work on a best-in class Open Banking decision-making platform and learn how to build systems that operate with low latency, at scale.
Our technology stack:
Python (including FastAPI, OpenTelemetry, procrastinate, SQLAlchemy, Uvicorn), Java,
React, Postgres, MySQL, Liquibase, Retool, Docker, AWS
What you’ll be doing
- Build and maintain features in our backend services, which can span any part of the lending lifecycle – from finding and onboarding new customers, to helping underwriters assess affordability, through to paying out and collecting loans
- Take part in the full software development lifecycle: contributing to designs, writing tests, reviewing code and helping with deployments
- Write clean, well-tested code in Python and Java, with guidance and feedback from senior engineers
- Work with colleagues in Product and Design, as well as internal users, to understand requirements and turn them into working software
- Help troubleshoot and resolve system issues that affect our customers, as part of a supported team rota during business hours
- Write and improve SQL queries against our Postgres databases
- Gradually take ownership of parts of the platform as your experience grows
- Build and improve frontend features in React, and grow your skills across the full stack
Who you are
- 0–2 years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent experience from a degree, bootcamp, internships or personal projects
- Working knowledge of Java and Python – you don't need to be an expert, but you're comfortable writing and debugging code in both
- Hands-on experience building frontend interfaces with React
- An understanding of core programming concepts such as data structures, object-oriented design and writing unit tests
- Familiarity with SQL and relational databases
- Comfortable using Git for version control
- A genuine interest in fintech and how financial products work
- A sharp eye for detail – in lending, small mistakes can have a real impact on customers
- You learn fast, pick up new tools and concepts quickly, and enjoy doing so
- You thrive in a fast-moving environment, are comfortable finding your way around a large, evolving codebase, and take initiative to work things out
- Good problem-solving skills and a methodical approach to debugging
- Clear communicator who asks questions, takes on feedback and works well in a team
- Keen to work across the full stack, from backend services and databases through to the frontend
- Able to work from our London office at least three days a week
Ideally you'll also have
- Experience with async Python or frameworks such as FastAPI
- Basic familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP or Azure) or Docker
- Knowledge of lending products or Open Banking
How we work at Abound
To be successful here, our culture needs to energise you. Here is how we operate:
- High Bar & Real Ownership: We are a high-performing team, and we hire people who raise the bar and take pride in great work. We own outcomes, not tasks.
- We Work Hard: We care about impact, not face time. At key moments, we go the extra mile to deliver for customers and the business.
- MVP & Iteration Culture: We ship fast, learn from real customers, and continuously improve our products and processes.
- One Team Collaboration: We collaborate deeply across engineering, product, operations, and the wider business.
- Thrive in Change: Priorities evolve as we learn what works. We value people who use good judgment, adapt quickly, and stay focused on outcomes.
What we offer
- Everyone owns a piece of the company - equity
- Hybrid with 3 days a week in the office
- 25 days’ holiday a year, plus 8 bank holidays
- 2 paid volunteering days per year
- One month paid sabbatical after 4 years
- Employee loan
- Free gym membership through WellHub
- Team wellness budget to be active together - set up a yoga class, a tennis lesson or go bouldering

jobs.title: Senior Control Systems Engineer – Vehicle Dynamics & Abstraction (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer to lead the design and execution of robust control layers across a highly diverse fleet of autonomous vehicles. In this role, you will act as the critical boundary layer to the upper autonomy stack. As the industry transitions toward End-to-End driving models, your primary mandate is to ensure that high-level motion commands are executed sensibly and strictly safeguarded at the physical limits of the vehicle.
Your designs will address complex, real-world scenarios rather than idealized environments. You will build control architectures that remain robust under severe, highly non-linear real-world conditions. This includes handling sudden tire slip, navigating challenging terrain such as mud, gravel, potholes, and dense vegetation, maintaining stability on steep inclines and side slopes, and delivering predictable tracking despite asymmetric system degradation, such as a damaged mechanics.
What is your Day to Day Mission:
- Control Architecture Abstraction: Maintain a standardized, platform-agnostic motion command interface that cleanly abstracts underlying mechanical complexity from the planning layers.
- Multivariable Control & Allocation: Design and deploy control laws to manage path tracking, velocity execution, and actuator saturation, incorporating data-driven control allocation to dynamically distribute effort across multiple actuators.
- System Identification & Modeling: Utilize data-driven system identification techniques to model unknown plant dynamics, latencies, and actuator responses.
- Pragmatic Simulation & Verification: Validate control loops rapidly. If filter design and linear/nonlinear analysis indicate a controller will behave, you are empowered to rely on lean, pragmatic subsystem simulations to iterate fast rather than being bottlenecked waiting for massive, full-system high-fidelity simulation runs.
- Motion Safeguarding: Ensure that incoming motion commands are dynamically evaluated, bounded, and safeguarded against the physical realities and constraints of the vehicle chassis in real time.
What you bring to the team:
- Experience: Proven professional experience developing and deploying real-time closed-loop control systems.
- Linear & Classical Control Design: Deep foundational command of classical control theory, including frequency-domain loop-shaping, stability margin analysis (Bode/Nyquist), and standard state-space design methods (LQR/pole-placement).
- System Identification & Allocation: Demonstrated experience utilizing system identification methods or empirical frequency response estimation to characterize raw plant dynamics, alongside data-driven control allocation techniques.
- Nonlinear Control Theory: Strong theoretical and practical foundation in Differential Geometry as applied to nonlinear systems, specifically utilizing Feedback Linearization and Differential Flatness for exact state transformation.
- State Estimation: Proficiency in Kalman Filtering for state estimation under non-holonomic constraints.
- Implementation & Tooling: High proficiency in either the MATLAB/Simulink, C++, or Python. The core requirement is your ability to translate complex control logic into clean, deterministic execution ready for real-time environments.
Your Benefits:
- Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles.
- Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities.
- Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life.
- Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget.
- Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer EMEA
jobs.description:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.
Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.
The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.
We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.
ABOUT THE ROLE
As a Senior Product Designer at WunderGraph, you are the connection between what our users will find most helpful and what our engineers build. Considering the users also happen to be other developers, this becomes an interesting challenge to think about the Developer Experience as the User Experience. You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale.
This is a wide-reaching role, as design roles at a startup should be. One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. You ground your work in evidence rather than assumption, partner closely with product and engineering, and turn what you learn about users into a clear, informed UX strategy that guides where we go next.
TEAM INTEGRATION
- Reports to the VP of Product; is part of the Product team
- Aligns closely with the CEO (Product) and Head of Customer Success (customer experience and business impact)
- Collaborate within the Product team with the Delivery Lead and the Design Engineer
- Collaborates cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, product, and customer success
ROLE OBJECTIVES
You are successful if you:
- Take ownership of the complete design lifecycle, bridging the gap between initial discovery and final delivery for web and product interfaces.
- Cultivate an evidence-based UX strategy that leverages user research and data to steer the product's evolution.
- Oversee the growth of a unified and extensible design system that spans both our product and marketing efforts.
- Convert user insights and organizational objectives into pragmatic, human-centric solutions engineered for long-term scalability.
- Advocate for excellence in accessibility, responsiveness, and performance as fundamental pillars of your craft.
- Provide mentorship to the team, sharing expertise in research methodologies and design principles.
- Refine the visual and functional identity of WunderGraph through meticulous and high-impact design work.
- Impact high-level product strategy by demonstrating how user-focused decisions drive tangible business impact.
ROLE TASKS
The role focuses on, but is not limited to:
Product Design
- Design and prototype user flows, interfaces, and interactions with scalability in mind.
- Own design problems end to end. From initial concept through execution and iteration after launch.
- Rapidly produce wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs, exploring multiple concepts and iterating quickly.
- Define and evolve our design system and component library, keeping it consistent and maintainable.
- Partner closely with engineers on feasibility, quality, and handoff, contributing to technical decisions (and coding where you're comfortable and it helps as a plus, not a requirement).
- Introduce advanced prototyping, interaction design, and motion practices.
UX Research & Strategy
- Plan and conduct user research across discovery and validation via user interviews, surveys, usability testing, and competitor analysis.
- Turn ambiguous product questions into decision-grade research that maps to real product and design decisions.
- Synthesize findings into clear insights, personas, journey maps, and opportunity areas that the team can act on.
- Build and maintain a shared insight repository so learning is reusable, searchable, and available to everyone.
- Translate research into an informed, evolving UX strategy that guides the roadmap and anchors design direction in real user needs.
- Advocate for the user in prioritization and roadmap discussions, and define what "better" looks like through clear UX success metrics.
- Run discovery workshops and share insights so research shows up where decisions are made like in design reviews, product planning, and standups embedding user knowledge from the get-go.
Web & Brand Experience
- Own the design and evolution of WunderGraph's web presence.
- Deliver assets that span product and marketing: landing pages, visuals, campaign graphics, and interactive components.
- Shape and maintain a cohesive style guide, balancing design innovation with consistency.
- Support brand storytelling with motion graphics and interactive elements.
ROLE REQUIREMENTS
- Senior-level experience in Product Design or UX/UI Design, with a strong portfolio of shipped work.
- Proven experience planning and running UX research (both generative and evaluative) and turning findings into strategy.
- Proficiency in Figma, prototyping tools, and Adobe Creative Suite.
- Strong background in UX and interaction design, accessibility, responsive design, and usability.
- Experience contributing to or leading design systems and component libraries.
- Comfortable using data and research to inform and defend design decisions.
- Working knowledge of front-end technologies (HTML/CSS, JavaScript a plus) enough to collaborate closely with engineers.
- Excellent communication, storytelling, and collaboration skills in English.
- A self-starter who is comfortable with ambiguity and can lead initiatives independently in a fast-moving startup.
- Comfortable working 100% remotely in a distributed team.
- Willingness to travel occasionally for team retreats and workshops.
Why WunderGraph?
- Work from wherever you thrive—we’re fully remote and globally distributed. If you're in Miami, come work with us in person! We also provide co-working space options worldwide if needed.
- Pick your preferred work hardware
- We focus on getting stuff done, and on having fun whilst doing so: work hard, play hard!

Note: This is a full-time, fully remote position, but we're prioritising candidates from EMEA. We are looking for someone who is available to work during European (CET) business hours.
The Process
We respect your time and interest in WunderGraph. This is why we're aiming to make the process as fast as possible. Here's what you can expect:

jobs.title: Security Engineer
jobs.description:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.
The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.
We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.
We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.
The Role
You will own security engineering end-to-end across application, infrastructure, and incident response: partnering with product and platform teams during design, writing and shipping security automation in production, and leading high-quality response when something breaks. Day to day, you will help define security in a greenfield modern bank, moving beyond threat modeling, harden cloud and CI/CD paths, build detection and response workflows, and drive remediation to closure with clear risk tradeoffs. This role reports to the CISO. What matters most is measurable risk reduction that keeps product velocity high.
Your First Six Months
Understand the foundations and increase your ownership rapidly.
- Months 1-2: Enforce an SSDLC that codifies existing security goals across EU-live payment/ledger services and US launch-critical services into required design, build, and release checkpoints (ownership, control evidence, and exception handling), with 100% of net-new Tier-1 changes following the workflow.
- Months 3-4: Stand up an AI-native product-security review pipeline that auto-triages code/dependency/IaC findings by service criticality, proposes fixes in pull requests, and routes owner-tagged remediation tasks and reduces non-actionable security alerts.
- Months 5-6: Expand baseline coverage to >=85% of Tier-1 services for workload identity hardening, secret management standards, runtime audit logging, and high-severity dependency monitoring; start monthly control-evidence reporting to Security & Compliance.
Who Will Thrive At Augustus
We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:
- American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.
- Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.
- Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.
- Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.
This role is for you if:
- You can point to security automation you personally built that replaced recurring manual review work.
- You have strong product security fundamentals and can improve secure-by-default patterns in fast-moving engineering teams.
- You have led end-to-end rollout of security controls in production, from design and implementation through adoption and evidence.
- You regularly influence architecture decisions before launch through fast, lightweight risk reviews and pragmatic controls.
- You are comfortable writing production-grade code or infrastructure changes, not only policy or tickets.
- You use AI tooling to accelerate security reviews and remediation planning without lowering quality or signal.
- You push ambiguous work forward without waiting for a complete playbook, and you bring stakeholders with you.
This is not for you if:
- You prefer advisory-only security roles and do not want direct implementation ownership.
- You need tightly scoped tickets to make progress and are uncomfortable defining the plan yourself.
- You avoid ownership of production systems and control implementation work.
- You optimize for stability over change and are not excited by early-stage ambiguity.
Hard Requirements
- Extensive experience in hands-on security engineering, product security, cloud security, or detection/response engineering in production environments
- Demonstrated expertise securing cloud-based systems (IAM, networking, logging, key management, workload isolation) and CI/CD pipelines
- Proven experience building at least one security automation or detection capability that is actively used in production
- Experience in fintech, payments, banking, or another regulated environment with audit and control evidence requirements
- Experience with modern security tooling, especially SIEM/SOAR and cloud security platforms
- Located in (or willing to relocate to) Berlin and able to work in-office 3 days/week
Pay transparency
Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual base salary range for this role is €100,000-€150,000 + equity.
What We Offer
- Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.
- Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.
- Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.
- Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.
Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.
Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.
Compensation: €100K – €150K • Offers Equity

jobs.description:
At Stark, we forge the future of European and national security through cutting-edge, AI-driven technology and unmatched engineering precision. As a premier defence technology company, our mission is clear: to equip NATO Allies and their partners with next-generation autonomous defence platforms and advanced AI-driven software built to perform in the world’s most demanding environments.
We believe that true security stems from relentless innovation. By combining elite engineering talent with agile technology and an AI-native operational culture, Stark turns complex defence challenges into field-tested, multi-domain solutions.
WHY JOIN US
- The software and systems you work on directly protect personnel and defend European and national sovereignty.
- You will work alongside industry-leading minds on autonomous systems, advanced propulsion, and secure cyber platforms.
- We foster a fast-paced, collaborative environment where bold ideas are supported by serious R&D backing.
ABOUT THE TEAM
Our embedded software team develops real-time safety-critical firmware and low-level software for autonomous defense platforms. We partner closely with hardware, systems, and controls engineers to take novel designs from concept to flight-ready software. You will join an agile cross-functional team focused on high-reliability execution in mission-critical environments.
YOUR MISSION
As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will architect, implement, and validate firmware and low-level software for autonomous defense platforms. You will drive hardware-software integration and ensure system reliability and safety standards are met across multi-domain environments.
WHAT YOU WILL DO AT STARK
- Architect and write high-performance C/C++ software and firmware for microcontroller and RTOS-based embedded systems.
- Develop low-level device drivers, bus communication protocols (CAN, SPI, I2C, Ethernet), and hardware abstraction layers.
- Lead hardware-software integration, system bring-up, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing in laboratory and field environments.
- Optimize software for low latency, memory constraints, and deterministic execution on embedded microcontrollers.
- Collaborate with hardware, systems, and QA teams to design robust fault-handling and safety-critical fail-safe mechanisms.
WHAT YOU BRING TO THE MISSION
- 5+ years of professional experience in embedded software development using C and C++.
- Deep experience with Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS such as FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or VxWorks) and bare-metal programming.
- Solid understanding of microcontrollers (ARM Cortex-M/R), peripheral interfaces (SPI, I2C, UART, CAN, Ethernet), and hardware schematics.
- Proficiency with debugging equipment (logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, JTAG/SWD debuggers) and automated testing frameworks.
- Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field.
NICE TO HAVE
- Experience with functional safety standards (ISO 26262, IEC 61508, or DO-178C).
- Familiarity with Embedded Linux, ROS/ROS2, or Rust for embedded systems.
- Prior experience in aerospace, robotics, defense, or automotive industries.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Data)
jobs.description:
Our Mission
We’re not your average benefits platform – we’re the driving force that uplifts people’s lives. Our technology connects the entire benefits ecosystem, creating better outcomes for employers, employees, brokers, and providers.
Our mission is clear: to build a world where everything works at its best, ensuring every employee gets the support they need to thrive—both at work and beyond.
Your Mission
As our Software Engineer (Data), you’ll build and run the pipelines, orchestration, and infrastructure that move data across Ben: in from our product and the tools we use, in from our customers, and back out to them again. It’s the plumbing the whole company and our customers depend on, and it has to stay reliable. We serve global enterprise customers with strict security and reliability requirements.
You’ll own real work from day one. You’ll have a strong team of cross functional engineers alongside you, room to grow into harder problems, and the freedom to do the job your way.
What you’ll be working on
- Own everything that flows into Ben: build and maintain the ingestion pipelines that bring data into our warehouse, with Fivetran for managed sources and custom pipelines where we need them.
- Keep everything running on time: own the orchestration that keeps data moving on schedule and recovers cleanly when something breaks.
- Scale and manage our data infrastructure: build and manage our data infrastructure as code with Terraform, using mainly AWS services.
- Connect Ben to every system our customers run: build enterprise-grade pipelines and connectors for our customers, bringing their data in, for example from HR and payroll systems, and getting accurate data back out to them, reliably and securely, even at the volumes large customers bring.
- Build the data layer our agents act on: help connect our data to the AI agents and services we're building, including through MCP connectors, so they get the right context at the right time.
- Shape what we build: work with product and other stakeholders to scope problems and agree on simple but scalable solutions.
- Build it to enterprise standard: build to current security practice, for example the OWASP Top 10 and the AWS Well-Architected Framework.
Behind the scenes
Ben runs on Python 3, Django, PostgreSQL, and React, on AWS.
Our data platform today is built around Fivetran, AWS DMS or custom pipelines for ingestion, dbt for transformation, PostgreSQL on AWS RDS as the warehouse, and n8n or AWS Lambda for automation between systems. We manage our infrastructure as code with Terraform and use different AWS services depending on requirements.
We have adopted frontier level agentic development practices and continue to push the envelope of what’s possible with current technologies.
Your skills and experience
- Strong experience with Python and SQL.
- A few years building and running production data pipelines that other people relied on.
- Comfortable with infrastructure as code, ideally Terraform, and hands-on with AWS, for example Lambda, ECS, Glue, S3, RDS.
- A good grasp of ETL/ELT and orchestration.
- Experience building or running data integrations and connectors, especially ones that other companies or customers depend on, is a real plus.
- Solid software engineering fundamentals: clean code, sensible design, and tests you can rely on.
- You keep security in mind when you build applications and configure infrastructure, and you know what enterprise customers expect of their data.
Nice to have, not essential:
- Experience working on customer-facing data integrations such as HRIS or payroll feeds via SFTP and in EDI format
- Experience with MCP server development, or different ways of preparing data for AI agents such as ontology modelling, context, knowledge graphs, and semantic layers.
We don't expect all of it. We do expect curiosity about it.
Why join us?
Ben's customers are large enterprise employers, and the hundreds of thousands of people who work for them rely on us to get their benefits right, every time. That depends on data moving accurately between their systems and ours, every cycle. You get to work on the data infrastructure that makes this run like clockwork.
At the same time, Ben is an AI-native organisation. Agents are already doing a lot of impactful work here, and they can only do it on data they can trust. That raises questions a dashboard never had to answer. How fresh does this need to be for an agent to act on it? How do you match the same entity across tools? How do you control what an agent is allowed to see? Very few engineers have answered those in production. You'd be one of them.
You'll take ownership of large, complex problem spaces, help design how they scale, and build an agentic layer few engineers have built anywhere yet, and you'll see the impact of it: Ben supports hundreds of thousands of people across 30+ countries.
Our Compensation & Benefits
It's important to us to practise what we preach when it comes to benefits. We know what good looks like and we want to provide the best for our team, with a comprehensive and inclusive benefits package. You'll have a choice over the things that are most important to you. You can see a selection below, with the full offering here.
💰 Competitive base salary + equity, so you own what you build
⭐ Bonus scheme designed to reward and recognise high performance
💳 £100 monthly personal Ben Balance: for whatever works for you, whether that's Netflix, Spotify, or a really expensive cup of coffee! This allowance will increase by £50 for each year of service until you reach £250
🍔 Weekly lunch provided in office so you can spend quality time with the team over some tasty food!
🏖 28 days of holidays a year plus bank holidays, and an option to buy or sell 2 days per year. Your holiday entitlement increases to 30 days at your 3rd year of service!
🌴 Work-from-abroad scheme, so you can support your travels, enjoy an extended holiday, or visit loved ones.
🍼 Enhanced parental leave and workplace nursery scheme to support with the cost of childcare in a nursery setting
❤️ Comprehensive Private Medical Insurance
💌 Funded Life Assurance cover with the option to voluntarily increase. This also includes an annual health check
Diversity and Culture at Ben
We are organically growing a brilliantly diverse, inclusive and respectful bunch of people we are extremely proud of. This should go without saying, but all applications are very much welcome. - Communicate and translate complex technical requirements to our Product and Engineering teams, including data gaps such as unclustered or unattributed services that you find in the field
- Become a trusted technical advisor to both internal and external customers, identifying business opportunities and substantially increasing our foothold with private sector customers and prospects

- Practical understanding of compliance, investigative, and risk workflows, and can speak credibly from practitioner experience in investigations, compliance, fraud, risk, or security
- A technical generalist background, comfortable with REST API integrations and familiar with how data is structured in SQL, and always interested in learning more

- The ability to communicate clearly with both technical and executive audiences
- Curiosity, fast learning, and motivation to solve difficult customer problems

- Fluency in English

- Proficiency in Python, REST API integrations, and SQL databases

One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.
