jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Postdoctoral Researcher Position Deep Learning for Functional-Oxide Growth Video-to-Spectrum Prediction by RHEED / XRD Fusion
jobs.description:
PROJECT OVERVIEW
We are looking for a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to develop innovative deeplearning models that predict the structure of functional-oxide thin films directly from their growth dynamics. Positioned at the interface between Artificial Intelligence and materials physics, the OXYD-IA project aims to design a deep model able to predict the final X-ray Diffraction (XRD) spectrum of an oxide thin film from the sole Reflection High-Energy Electron Diffraction (RHEED) video recorded during its growth by Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE).
The resulting tool will open the way to predictive, in situ control of oxide epitaxy – a process today dominated by a costly trial-and-error approach, in which the structural and functional properties of the films are only validated ex situ. You will join a genuinely multidisciplinary collaboration between the INL (Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon), which provides the operando experimental data and materials-physics expertise, and the LIRIS (équipe Imagine), which provides the deep video-learning and probabilistic-modelling methodology – both at École Centrale de Lyon.
A high-impact opportunity. AI for experimental physics is a fast-growing field, and OXYD-IA offers a genuine first-mover advantage within it: you would work on a unique, unpublished dataset of paired RHEED videos and XRD spectra to build one of the first video-to-spectrum models with calibrated uncertainty for oxide growth. By learning directly from experimental 1 data, such a model can short-circuit the traditional trial-and-error loop, accelerate discovery and drastically cut experimental time, cost, precursor consumption and instrument occupancy – turning routine in situ diagnostics into predictive tools.
Scientific context. Epitaxial perovskite-oxide thin films exhibit rich, tunable functional properties (thermoelectricity, ferroelectricity, piezoelectricity) governed by their structure and composition, themselves correlated with the growth conditions. MBE offers independent control of each element but, applied to oxides, is notoriously unstable and poorly reproducible because of the oxidising atmosphere. RHEED tracks the surface dynamics in real time (lattice parameter, surface reconstructions, roughness) but does not give access to the final bulk microstructure, which is only reachable ex situ via XRD / XRR. There is therefore a strong physical link – so far unexploited quantitatively – between RHEED dynamics and final XRD microstructure, which OXYD-IA proposes to learn directly.
Figure 1 – OXYD-IA pipeline. At inference, the RHEED video acquired during growth (INL) feeds a deep video encoder (LIRIS) and a probabilistic regression module that predicts the final XRD spectrum together with its uncertainty. During training, the predicted spectrum is compared with the ex situ XRD / XRR spectrum measured at INL (ground truth); this discrepancy is the supervised learning signal that adjusts the model parameters.
KEY RESEARCH AREAS AND RESPONSIBILITIES
You will drive the core computational research along a risk-managed, phased 12-month roadmap. The primary target is a versioned RHEED / XRD dataset, growth-regime classification and probabilistic regression of the key structural parameters with calibrated uncertainty; full-spectrum prediction, a real-time demonstrator and cross-oxide generalisation are stretch and follow-on objectives. The work is organised around three technical pillars:
1. Corpus structuring and spatio-temporal RHEED representation • Build a versioned dataset by cleaning, temporally aligning and pairing the RHEED video sequences, the associated MBE parameters (temperature, oxygen pressure, source fluxes) and the ex situ XRD / XRR spectra (SrTiO3 reference system). • Pre-train, in a self-supervised manner, a spatio-temporal video encoder (3D CNN, e.g. R(2+1)D, or temporal Vision Transformer) fine-tuned on the laboratory corpus. • Perform fuzzy / Bayesian classification of the growth regimes (2D vs. 3D modes, transitions, RHEED oscillations), building on LIRIS expertise in the statistical analysis of sequences.
2. Probabilistic RHEED →XRD regression with uncertainty quantification • Design a latent representation that couples the video encoding with the physical MBE parameters. • Learn stepwise – first scalar structural parameters (lattice parameter, density, mosaicity), more robust at small N, then the full 1D XRD spectrum. • Provide calibrated uncertainty estimates (Bayesian approaches or deep ensembles), indispensable for guiding real-time decisions during growth.
3. Real-time demonstrator and dissemination (stretch / follow-on) • Validate the model on new SrTiO3 growths and prototype an in-growth inference tool at the end of the NANOFUTUR MBE line. • Mitigate the small-data and generalisation challenges through temporal data augmentation, transfer learning from pre-trained video encoders and domain adaptation towards other functional oxides. • Contribute toward a high-impact joint publication at the AI / materials interface (the project milestone is the submission of a joint paper).
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
• A Ph.D. in the field of Artificial Intelligence – Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision or Signal Processing, and we are looking for a senior postdoc with 2–5 years of post-PhD experience.
• Deep learning on sequential / video data: demonstrable, hands-on experience with 3D CNNs, temporal transformers and / or probabilistic models. Proficiency in Python and PyTorch (or TensorFlow) is mandatory.
• A genuine appetite for physics: a strong curiosity for, or prior exposure to, experimental physics and materials science. The ideal candidate carried out an AI-focused Ph.D. and is eager to apply it to a real materials-physics problem.
• Research mindset: a track record of innovation and the ability to work autonomously on a complex, multidisciplinary project. • Software skills: experience with Git version control and reproducible research.
• Excellent communication and scientific-writing skills in English.
ADDITIONAL SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES
• Self-supervised video pre-training, uncertainty quantification (Bayesian / ensembles), fuzzy classification, or domain adaptation.
• Experience with small-sample / transfer-learning settings and handling large-scale experimental datasets.
HOW TO APPLY
Please prepare a single PDF file containing:
1. A detailed Curriculum Vitae, including a list of publications.
2. A 1-page motivation letter explaining your specific interest in this project and how your background addresses the key responsibilities and qualifications listed above.
3. The names and contact information of at least two academic references.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Developer Experience
jobs.description:
Xendit is an enterprise payments platform powering complex financial operations across Southeast Asia and global markets. We provide a unified API layer combining payment processing, global payouts, localized FX, identity compliance, and fraud protection. As a trusted financial partner backed by top-tier global investors, Xendit processes high-throughput transaction flows for leading global platforms including Meta, Traveloka, ByteDance, Wise, and Grab, building resilient payment infrastructure to drive regional commerce forward.
Why this role exists
For a payment-infrastructure company, the product is in large part the API. Developers are both the buyers and the daily users, and the quality of the APIs, SDKs, docs, sandbox, and integration path is the product's real surface. This role owns the developer's journey from first API call to production and scale, the difference between a developer who integrates in an afternoon and one who gives up before their first successful transaction.
What you'll own
- The roadmap for the developer experience: integration flow, SDKs, documentation, sandbox, error handling, and time-to-first-successful-call.
- Developer activation and retention as headline metrics, from sign-up to first production transaction and beyond.
- Discovery grounded in developer behavior: integration analytics, support and community signals, and direct developer research.
- Partnership with Engineering on API design and DX standards, and prioritization of DX debt against new capabilities.
- Clear communication of trade-offs to senior stakeholders, and translation of platform changes into a coherent developer-facing experience.
How you will work
You report to the Product Design & UX Director for Customer Lifecycle and work most closely with Engineering, whose API and platform decisions shape the experience you own. Part of your early work is helping define where developer-experience ownership sits, since this surface has not had a dedicated product owner before. You are the strategic owner of the developer journey from first API call to production. Your time splits between developer discovery and roadmap delivery, with constant engineering partnership. The domain works from validated findings rather than assumptions and values direct, candid critique.
What we're looking for
- PM experience with API, platform, or developer-facing products. You have owned products where developers are the user.
- Genuine technical fluency. You can read API docs and discuss schemas, auth, and webhooks with engineers, here this is a requirement, not a nice-to-have.
- Demonstrated empathy for developer workflows. You understand how developers actually work and where they get stuck.
A strong plus: a background as a developer, or having built SDK, docs, or DX products; payments or fintech experience.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer
jobs.description:
TITLE: Staff Software Engineer
REPORTING TO: CTO
LOCATION: Marina del Rey, CA – OR – Williamsburg, NY (onsite M - F)
Who Is Flip?
Flip builds AI voice agents that handle millions of real customer conversations for some of the biggest brands, healthcare providers, and transportation companies in the world. When you call a company and the AI actually solves your problem — tracks the order, processes the return, refills the prescription — that’s us.
We’re a low-ego team. We don’t need the limelight or the stardom — we care about solving really hard problems, fast. And here’s the part worth stopping on: outside the frontier labs, almost nobody is running AI in production at this scale. We are — millions and millions of live phone calls, handled by an engineering team a fraction of the size you’d expect. Very few teams our size serve this volume, and the reason is simple: we hold a very high bar for development.
How we think
From day one, we’ve operated on first principles, and the first principle is the customer. If you have strong conviction that something delivers real business value for your customer, it shouldn’t die in red tape or committee. You ship it — fast and often — because the customer is what actually matters. That’s why there’s a direct line from your keyboard to production here. We didn’t remove the committee to move fast for its own sake; we removed it because conviction plus customer obsession doesn’t need a permission slip.
Agentic development has changed the way we work — we’re not shy about that. What it hasn’t changed is the necessity of experience, especially at the production level. You can ship faster than ever now; that doesn’t negate experience. Speed without judgment is how you break things millions of people depend on. That’s why this posting asks for senior and staff engineers: we’re hiring builders whose experience makes the new speed safe.
Our view is simple: let builders build. We care a lot less about stack experience or corporate pedigree than most companies — and a lot more about whether you’ve looked past the noise and want to build product you’re genuinely proud of. Tools change monthly now. The instinct to build doesn’t.
We keep the team lean on purpose — a high bar, real support, real resources — because that’s where builders truly express themselves. The most common thing we hear from engineers after joining Flip is some version of “I could never have done this at my last company”.
Deep industry expertise matched with ruthless execution creates wonderful work. That’s the whole formula.
What you’ll build
We’re serving an orchestrated system of agents answering millions of contacts daily and now also expanding into other modalities like chat. Pulling that off requires elite engineering paired with incredible DevOps — voice is unforgiving: it’s real-time, there are no retries or page refreshes, and the customer is literally on the line.
The work breaks into three lanes:
- Vertical engineering — building the agents themselves: complex multi-step customer workflows and deep integrations into the contact center and the industries we serve — order systems, healthcare workflows, logistics. This is where “mostly works” isn’t shippable.
- Platform engineering — the orchestration layer every agent runs on: routing, state, tool use, and the primitives that let vertical teams ship fast without reinventing the engine.
- Inference & DevOps — we host our own models; low-latency serving at production scale is a core competency here, not a vendor line item. Plus the telephony, observability, and deployment infrastructure that keeps millions of live calls healthy.
And the range here is real. Our engineers do everything from sitting face-to-face with customers to going deep on complex backend systems — you really get to pick where you fit. We don’t slot you into one of these on day one. There’s probably a place for you — we’ll find it together, and it’ll probably change as we grow.
What we look for
We intentionally wrote this as one role for senior and staff engineers, because we believe builders love to build — and how they build varies. Some want the flexibility of working alone and joining forces when it counts; some do their best work in a small pod. We don’t prescribe it. What we do hold as a core principle: we are always raising the bar on each other. As we grow, our best builders often end up with two or three engineers building behind them — if that’s a direction you want, it’s here. And if you’d rather stay a pure builder, that raises the bar too.
-
- Real production experience. You’ve built and owned systems where failure had consequences. We don’t count years — we look at what you’ve shipped and what you learned shipping it.
- Judgment that survives contact with production. Agentic development is how we work — but what we’re actually hiring is your experience: knowing what to ship, what to slow down on, and what never to ship at all.
- Low ego, high execution. You own outcomes, not tickets. You’d rather ship the thing than present the plan for the thing.
- Customer obsession. You want to be close to the problem — sometimes literally in the room — and you measure yourself by what the customer got.
More About Us
- We're international, spanning the US, UK, and Canada.
- We’ve raised +$30M to date including our recent $20M Series A - backed by Ridge, Next Coast, ScOp, Bullpen Capital, Data Point and Forum Ventures, as well as founders & executives from Amazon Alexa, Ada, Attentive and Simon Data.
- Our tech stack includes Python, MongoDB, AWS, Twilio, Datadog, Snowflake, and Omni.
- Comprehensive healthcare and unlimited vacation, including a mandatory half week for everyone over July 4, and a full week off at the end of the year.
- In the office 5 days/week, we collaborate in real time on the desk.
Final compensation may vary based on location, experience, and qualifications. This role is also eligible for equity, in accordance with company policy, and subject to board approval.
Compensation Range:
$200,000—$400,000 USD
Our customers span the globe, and so do our offices. Flip is committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all employees, applicants, and covered individuals regardless of protected characteristics. We want our company to be as diverse and inclusive as our customers.

jobs.title: Head of Information Security
jobs.description:
About Amartha
Amartha is a technology company focused on creating shared prosperity by developing digital financial solutions for the grassroots economy. Founded in 2010 as a microfinance institution, Amartha connects rural, women-led micro-enterprises with affordable capital. Amartha is expanding as a tech company, building a microfinance ecosystem that connects to the growing digital economy through capital, investment, and payment services. By boosting the competitiveness of micro and small entrepreneurs, Amartha empowers women-led MSMEs, creates jobs, and fosters inclusive economic growth.
Our Empowered to Grow culture guides how we work together. We Focus on Clarity, Take the Lead, and Grow Impact, empowering our people to take ownership and create meaningful, lasting impact.
About the Role
Amartha is an Indonesian fintech group that provides financial services to micro-entrepreneurs through several licensed entities in lending, payments, and related services. We are looking for a Head of Information Security to take the group's security posture to the next level.
You will set the security strategy for the whole group, lead the security team, and work with engineering, product, risk, legal, and the Board to protect our customers, their funds, and their data. The role combines program leadership, regulatory engagement, and enough technical depth to direct security engineering on cloud and Kubernetes platforms.
What You Will Do
- Set and run the group information security strategy, roadmap, and budget.
- Lead and grow the security team across GRC and data privacy, and security engineering, including hiring and developing team leads.
- Own security policies, standards, and the information security management system (ISO 27001) across all entities.
- Act as the main contact for regulators, auditors, and certification bodies on information security matters.
- Build identity, privileged access, and secret management controls for cloud and Kubernetes production environments.
- Lead detection and incident response, including the security operations (SOC) model, incident playbooks, and regulatory reporting.
- Design security controls for payment flows and partner integrations, together with engineering and finance.
- Run the application security program: security design review, penetration testing, vulnerability management, and bug bounty.
- Manage third-party and vendor security risk.
- Support data protection compliance under UU PDP, together with Legal.
- Build security awareness across the company, from field staff to leadership.
- Report security risk and program progress to the Chief Risk Officer, the executive team, and the Board risk committee.
What You Bring
- 10 or more years in information security, including at least 5 years leading a security function in a regulated financial institution, such as a bank, multifinance company, P2P lending platform, payment provider, or e-money issuer.
- Experience leading incident response and working directly with financial regulators.
- A track record of raising the maturity of a security program in a measurable way.
- Experience managing managers and leading a team of 15 or more across GRC and security engineering.
- Working knowledge of Indonesian regulations on information technology risk and data protection in financial services.
- Experience as the accountable owner of ISO 27001 certification and surveillance audits.
- Hands-on depth in cloud and Kubernetes security: RBAC, workload identity, admission control, runtime detection, and secret management.
- Experience with privileged access management, just-in-time access, and phishing-resistant MFA.
- Experience with SIEM and SOC operating models, both in-house and managed.
- Ability to explain security risk in business terms to executives and the Board.
- Fluent written and spoken Bahasa Indonesia and English, including formal correspondence with regulators.
Nice to have
- CISSP, CISM, or CISA. CCSP or another cloud security certification.
- Fintech competency certificate from an OJK-registered professional certification body (LSP) or from AFPI.
- Experience with multi-cloud environments and cloud migrations.
- Experience with fraud prevention and transaction monitoring controls.
- Experience securing AI agents and LLM-based tools.
At Amartha, we are dedicated to creating a workplace that celebrates diversity, ensures equity, and fosters inclusion. We believe that diverse perspectives—shaped by factors such as gender, age, race, ethnicity, education, culture, and life experiences—drive innovation and growth.
We actively welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us in building an environment where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered. Our commitment is to provide equal opportunities and foster a sense of belonging that enables our employees to thrive and make meaningful contributions.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
About Amartha
At Amartha, we empower micro-businesses across Indonesia, enabling growth and equal prosperity. We've supported over 3.5+ million enterpreneurs–mostly women–by disbursing 2 billion USD in funding. As we step into 2026, Amartha is evolving into a technology-driven financial ecosystem, expanding our reach in lending, funding, and payments. Through innovation and digital solutions, we aim to enhance accessibility, streamline processes, and create a seamless user experience.
Roles and Responsibilities:
- Design, develop, and productionize ML models for credit scoring, underwriting, fraud detection, collections, and portfolio risk management.
- Build robust features from customer, transaction, repayment, behavioral, and alternative data.
- Select and evaluate appropriate algorithms, with emphasis on explainable and high-performing models such as XGBoost.
- Define offline and online evaluation metrics aligned with lending outcomes and business objectives.
- Address class imbalance, data leakage, bias, model stability, and changing customer behavior.
- Build reliable training, validation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining pipelines.
- Monitor model performance, calibration, drift, fairness, and operational impact in production.
- Produce clear model documentation and explain decisions to risk, product, engineering, compliance, and business stakeholders.
- Collaborate with data engineers and software engineers to integrate models into scalable production systems.
- Conduct experiments and translate model improvements into measurable business outcomes.
- Explore practical LLM and agentic-AI applications, such as document processing, underwriting assistance, investigation workflows, and internal productivity tools.
Requirements
- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
- 5+ years of ML Engineering or Data Scientist experience
- Strong foundation in traditional machine learning, including classification, regression, feature engineering, model evaluation, and imbalanced-data handling.
- Hands-on experience with models such as XGBoost, LightGBM, random forests, and logistic regression.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer (Cloud and Platform Security)
jobs.description:
About Amartha
Amartha is a technology company focused on creating shared prosperity by developing digital financial solutions for the grassroots economy. Founded in 2010 as a microfinance institution, Amartha connects rural, women-led micro-enterprises with affordable capital. Amartha is expanding as a tech company, building a microfinance ecosystem that connects to the growing digital economy through capital, investment, and payment services. By boosting the competitiveness of micro and small entrepreneurs, Amartha empowers women-led MSMEs, creates jobs, and fosters inclusive economic growth.
Our Empowered to Grow culture guides how we work together. We Focus on Clarity, Take the Lead, and Grow Impact, empowering our people to take ownership and create meaningful, lasting impact.
About the role
Amartha is an Indonesian fintech group that provides financial services to micro-entrepreneurs through several licensed entities in lending, payments, and related services. Our production platform runs on Google Cloud and Kubernetes, and our security team is building the controls, detection, and automation that a regulated lender needs at that scale.
We are looking for a Senior Security Engineer to own cloud and platform security engineering. You will run the controls that detect and prevent misconfiguration and intrusion across our cloud and container estate, respond to what our detection stack surfaces, and turn manual security infrastructure into code. You will work alongside DevOps and platform engineering, and your work feeds directly into our ISO 27001 and regulator audit evidence.
This is a hands-on individual contributor role with a wide mandate. You will be the senior voice on cloud security in the team, and we expect you to set the technical direction for it rather than wait for a backlog.
What you will do
- Own container and cloud runtime security: workload isolation, Kubernetes hardening, and runtime threat detection.
- Run and extend automated benchmark and configuration scanning across our cloud platform and productivity suite, and act on what it finds.
- Build shift-left security into CI/CD: infrastructure-as-code scanning and misconfiguration gates before deployment.
- Bring the security team's own cloud estate under infrastructure as code. Provisioning is manual and drift-prone today, and ending that is a named deliverable of this role.
- Build and run the deployment pipeline for our security tooling, so security infrastructure ships the same way the product does.
- Own the SIEM platform end to end: network isolation, version currency, configuration management, and detection coverage across critical workloads.
- Respond to and review security alerts, tune detection rules, and cut false positives.
- Manage edge and perimeter security: web application firewall rules, DNS and traffic visibility, and security event retention.
- Manage the platform and console access paths that sit with security engineering.
- Document what you build, to the standard where another engineer can operate it without you. Continuity is a measured outcome of this role, not a nice-to-have.
- Share the information security on-call rotation, and help us establish it.
- Produce the control evidence our auditors and regulators ask for, with the GRC team.
What you bring
- 5 or more years in security engineering, infrastructure engineering, or SRE, with at least 3 years focused on cloud and container security.
- Hands-on depth in public cloud and Kubernetes security: identity and access management, RBAC, workload identity, network policy, admission control, runtime detection, and secret management. Google Cloud is our primary platform.
- Production experience with a SIEM, including deployment, detection rule authoring, and alert triage.
- Infrastructure as code in practice, not in theory: reusable modules, state management, and deployment pipelines you built and operated yourself.
- Experience embedding security scanning into CI/CD, such as infrastructure-as-code scanning, static analysis, container image scanning, or policy as code.
- Working knowledge of cloud benchmark and hardening standards, and the judgement to decide which findings matter.
- Scripting and automation in Python, Go, or Bash.
- A documentation habit. We need an engineer who writes runbooks without being asked, because the gap this role fills is as much continuity as it is technical.
- Fluent written and spoken Bahasa Indonesia and English.
Nice to have
- Experience in a regulated financial institution: bank, multifinance company, P2P lending platform, payment provider, or e-money issuer.
- Familiarity with Indonesian regulation on information technology risk and data protection in financial services, in particular POJK 4/2021 and UU PDP.
- Exposure to ISO 27001 control evidence, internal audit, or external certification audits.
- Cloud or Kubernetes security certification: GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, CKS, or equivalent.
- Exposure to threat intelligence platforms, vulnerability and finding management, or cloud compliance and posture management.
- Experience building or running an on-call rotation for a security function.
- Multi-cloud exposure, in particular a migration between major cloud providers.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Data Scientist (Fulfilment)
jobs.description:
Company Description
About Grab and Our Workplace
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
Job Description
Get to Know the Team
The Fulfilment Tech Family builds distributed systems and machine learning platforms that power Grab's multi-sided marketplace across Southeast Asia. We process hundreds of millions of real-time requests each day to manage supply allocation, dispatch, order matching, and dynamic pricing across mobility and deliveries. Our mission is to balance customer reliability, driver-partner earnings, and operational efficiency under volatile real-world conditions. We foster a collaborative, research-to-production culture focused on scalable algorithmic impact.
Get to Know the Role
As Senior Principal Data Scientist, you will be the senior individual contributor lead architecting Grab's next generation of autonomous marketplace decisioning systems. Working at the intersection of reinforcement learning, latent world models, and generative AI, you will guide technical strategy and translate research into production systems serving millions of users. You will be the technical lead for a specialised team of scientists and engineers, reporting directly to the Head of Data Science. You will also base full-time onsite at Grab's One-North office in Singapore. If you are passionate about pioneering real-time, learning-driven marketplace systems at massive scale, join us!
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
- You will architect and implement end-to-end reinforcement learning pipelines (offline RL, model-based RL, and simulation) to jointly automate pricing, dispatch, and supply repositioning decisions.
- You will design latent world models and spatio-temporal marketplace state representations that capture complex supply-demand interactions and multi-temporal levers.
- You will establish formal off-policy evaluation (OPE) frameworks, conservative value estimation baselines, and safety guardrails to de-risk live deployment in production.
- You will build behavioural simulation systems using fine-tuned open-source large language models (LLMs) to forecast and simulate user and partner decision dynamics.
- You will partner with backend, streaming, and platform engineering teams to deploy low-latency, closed-loop decision agents into high-throughput production environments.
- You will leverage modern Generative AI development tools and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate prototyping, code quality, testing, and technical documentation across the team.
Qualifications

- You have a PhD in Computer Science, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative discipline with at least 10 years of post-degree experience leading complex machine learning research and production initiatives (or Master's degree with at least 12 years of equivalent experience).

jobs.description:

Job Description
Get to Know the Team
The Fulfilment Tech Family builds the systems that power Grab's marketplaces across Southeast Asia. We design real-time, distributed systems and Machine Learning (ML) solutions that process hundreds of millions of requests each day. Our work drives supply allocation, pricing, and order matching for millions of users and driver-partners.Our mission is three-fold:
- Deliver products that work for our driver-partners
- Meet consumer demand, regardless of conditions
- Build marketplaces that balance experience and cost for everyone involved
We are looking for a Senior Principal Data Scientist to lead our shift toward automated marketplace optimization. You'll advance how we use data and ML to automate pricing, dispatch, and supply management decisions.
Get to Know the Role
This is a Senior Principal individual contributor role where you'll build the foundation for autonomous, learning-driven marketplace systems. You'll work at the intersection of reinforcement learning, large language models, and production systems that operate at scale.
Your work centres on two areas:
- Reinforcement Learning (RL) Systems: You'll develop systems that jointly optimize pricing, dispatching, and supply repositioning. You'll build decision agents that handle multiple objectives and adapt when real-world conditions change.
- LLM-Based Behavioural Intelligence: You'll architect systems using fine-tuned language models to predict, explain, and simulate user decision-making at scale. These models will power the next generation of marketplace automation.
You'll serve as the technical lead for a small team, guiding both research direction and production implementation. You'll report to the Head of Data Science and work from Grab's One-North Singapore office.
The Critical Tasks You will Perform
You will:
- Design and implement end-to-end RL systems that combine model-based RL, offline RL, simulation, and online learning into a unified training pipeline. This includes creating state representations and reward structures that balance short-term results with long-term outcomes.
- Build latent world models and marketplace state representations that capture supply-demand interactions, location-based patterns, and behavioural signals from users and drivers.
- Develop systems that optimize across multiple marketplace levers simultaneously—pricing, dispatching, and supply repositioning—to expand the set of achievable outcomes for the business.
- Create policy evaluation frameworks and establish monitoring systems that allow safe deployment of new decision-making policies in production.
- Fine-tune open-source large language models on domain-specific data to build capabilities for prediction, reasoning, and simulation within marketplace applications.
- Design and implement training strategies for language models, including supervised fine-tuning, preference-based alignment, and iterative improvement methods.
- Work with data engineers and backend engineers to integrate RL and LLM systems into real-time production environments serving millions of users.
Qualifications
What Essential Skills You Will Need
- You have PhD in Computer Science, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, or related field with at least 10 years of experience — to lead complex technical initiatives spanning research and production systems.
- You are proficient in RL fundamentals — including Markov Decision Processes, stochastic control, and reward design trade-offs. You'll apply these to build closed-loop systems that make sequential decisions in the marketplace.
- You have experience building production ML/ RL systems with online learning or simulation-based optimization — to deploy models that learn and adapt in real-time environments.
- You have knowledge in world models and sequential modelling — including latent dynamic models (RNNs, transformers, state-space models) and representation learning for complex systems. You'll use these to model marketplace dynamics accurately.
- You have hands-on experience fine-tuning large language models in production — including supervised fine-tuning and at least one preference-based alignment method (RLHF, DPO, or GRPO). You'll apply parameter-efficient methods (LoRA, QLoRA, or PEFT) and understand their trade-offs in accuracy, memory, and cost.
- You can design evaluation frameworks for generative models — including metrics for factual accuracy and reasoning quality. You'll use these to validate model outputs before deployment.
- You have experience with distributed training frameworks — such as DeepSpeed, FSDP, or Megatron-LM. You'll use these to train large models efficiently across multiple GPUs or nodes.
- You are proficient in Python and ML frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow) — to implement models and integrate with production codebases.
- You have experience with scalable computing platforms — such as Spark or Ray. You'll use these to process large datasets and distribute training workloads.
- You can translate ambiguous business problems into concrete modelling tasks — to identify what can be solved with ML/RL and define the scope, data requirements, and success criteria.

Join Grab's Red Team & Threat Intel team, which helps improve the security posture of Grab's products, platforms, cloud environments, AI systems, and enterprise technology across Southeast Asia.
The team partners with Security, Engineering, Infrastructure, IT, and business teams. This partnership enables the team to emulate real-world adversaries, identify the highest-impact risks, and help Grab strengthen its preventive, detective, and response capabilities. The Threat Intel function brings external incident trends, adversary behaviours, and internal improvement opportunities into Grab's security priorities. This helps the team plan intelligence-led Purple Team exercises, advise leadership, and support risk prioritisation with the Vulnerability Management team. We work with curiosity, technical depth, and responsibility, using offensive security techniques and threat intelligence to make Grab safer for our users, partners, and Grabbers.
Get to Know the Role
You will report to the Red Team & Threat Intel team leader and perform complex red team operations across cloud, CI/CD, endpoint, identity, application, and AI environments. You will design realistic attack simulations, develop offensive tooling, apply threat intelligence to Purple Team planning, and turn findings into practical improvements for engineering and security teams.
This role is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. You will help shaping Grab's Red Team and Threat Intel capabilities, and influence how we use AI and automation to scale offensive security work responsibly. If you enjoy building tools, testing assumptions, and helping defenders get sharper, we will give you the platform to make a regional impact.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
- You will lead end-to-end red team operations, and intelligence-led Purple Team exercises with the Blue Team. These exercises will emulate realistic adversary behaviour across multiple environments, including cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, identity systems, endpoints, and applications.
- You will develop command-and-control tooling, implants, payload delivery mechanisms, and operator workflows for authorised security exercises.
- You will red team AI systems, including internal copilots, agentic workflows, AI-assisted operational tools, and MLOps environments.
- You will use AI tools to improve research, automation, payload development, reporting, operational planning, and analysis of defensive coverage.
- You will translate red team findings and threat intelligence into clear engineering actions. You will partner with defenders, platform teams, and the Vulnerability Management team to improve detection, response, hardening, security architecture, and risk prioritisation.
- You will work with other team members on offensive security tradecraft, tool development, operational safety, documentation, and responsible execution of adversary simulations.
- You will contribute to the Red Team and Threat Intel roadmap. Your contributions will involve identifying the latest attack techniques and evaluating new tooling.
- You will produce Threat Intel assessments from security incidents observed in the wild or improvement opportunities identified internally. Additionally, you will advise leadership on likely impact, priority, and next actions.
Qualifications
What Essential Skills You Will Need
- Min. Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, IT, or a related major
- You will have 4 or more years of experience in offensive security, red teaming, security engineering, exploit development, cloud security, or adjacent technical security roles.
- You will have hands-on experience developing command-and-control tooling, implants, loaders, payloads, or offensive automation.
- You will have practical experience assessing CI/CD systems, source control platforms, build pipelines, artefact repositories, secrets handling, and deployment workflows.
- You will have firm knowledge of cloud environments, including identity, networking, logging, container platforms, and common privilege escalation paths.
- You will have experience assessing AI-enabled products, internal AI platforms, or agentic systems in adversarial scenarios, and using AI tools to improve security research, workflows, and output quality.
- You will have experience producing or using Threat Intel to connect external incident trends, adversary tradecraft, and internal security signals to practical security decisions.
- Knowledge of the major 3 operating systems (Windows/Linux/macOS), endpoint internals, enterprise management, and defensive controls would be an added value

jobs.description:
Company Description
About Grab and Our Workplace
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
Job Description
Get to Know the Team
The Mobility team is an established team responsible for the ride-hailing module in the Grab app. We improve the core transport booking experience.
We are working on high throughput, real-time distributed systems that use machine learning techniques to solve hundreds of millions of requests per day. Our mission is to offer the best products and experiences to our passengers to increase adoption and engagement of our services. Our team has direct end-user contact, and impact on the bottom line for Grab.
Get to Know the Role
We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer, Backend to join our growing engineering team in Beijing, China. You will be reporting to Software Engineering Manager II and work at the intersection of backend product engineering and Site Reliability Engineering.
This role balances building new backend capabilities with improving the reliability, observability, and operational readiness of the services we own. Across an average quarter, you will spend approximately half your time on product and integration engineering, and half on reliability engineering. The split will flex around launches, incidents, and business priorities.
You will design, build, and operate backend systems that support Mobility at scale. You will work closely with Product, Operations, Analytics, partner-facing teams, and engineers across Grab to deliver reliable customer and partner experiences.
This role is onsite based in our Beijing, China office.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
- You will work with Product/Design/Analytics teams to understand problems, requirements, provide feedback, options, trade offs, and timelines.
- You will collaborate with Android/IOS/Backend/QA/ML Engineers to brainstorm and implement technical solutions that are scalable and addressing the actual problems.
- You will write code that is reusable, scalable and testable. Make sure features are delivered on time and with high quality.
- You will review code and engineering specs, provide constructive feedback and aim to raise the engineering bar.
- You will be responsible and responsive during on-call duty. Triage, debug, mitigate and fix complex issues. Assist on ad hoc queries from other teams.
- You will mentor junior engineers and contribute to the team's overall growth and knowledge sharing
Qualifications
What Essential Skills You Will Need
- You have Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field
- You have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience in distributed systems environments
- You have proficiency in at least one backend programming language (Go, C++, Python, or similar)
- You have experience with computer science fundamentals, including algorithms, data structures, and system design principles
- You have experience designing and operating high-throughput or real-time distributed systems.
- You understand production failure modes, including partial failures, timeouts, retries, duplicate events, eventual consistency, and dependency degradation.
- You have solid knowledge of relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, MongoDB, Cassandra, or similar)
- You have hands-on experience with production observability, including metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, and runbooks.
- You understand reliability practices such as SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, safe deployments, rollback strategies, capacity planning, and postmortem follow ups.
- You have experience with cloud infrastructure, like AWS, and modern delivery practices such as CI/CD, containers, and infrastructure automation.
- You collaborate effectively across engineering and non-engineering functions, communicate technical trade-offs clearly, and take ownership of outcomes.

We also run the catalog where analysts, data scientists and ML engineers find that data every day, increasingly through AI agents.

We have certified our most-used data assets and made them easy to find. The opportunity now is to get full value from this data by moving consumers onto it and off the long tail of tables they use today. We want a data PM who has built a data mesh or a shared enterprise data model and can use that experience to shape Grab's Data Mesh. Your job is to get every team and agent at Grab building on a consistent model of the business.
You will set the standards every producing team at Grab follows, and keep them light wherever the stakes are low. You will own the AI tools that data engineers and analysts use to build, test and query data, and drive their adoption across Grab.
This is an individual contributor role based onsite in Grab's headquarters in Singapore, reporting to the Head of Product, Data and AI Platforms.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
- You will own the strategy and roadmap for Grab's data mesh, and be responsible for data throughput over modeled data.
- You will own how Grab models its core business entities, how they map to physical data, and how they relate to each other.
- You will make modeled data products the default for analysis and for training Grab's AI models. Publishing one must take a domain team less work than publishing a raw table, and break the tradeoff with data duplication.
- You will own the data quality testing, with stricter tests for the data that matters most.
- You will decide which data Grab cannot afford to get wrong, by what breaks when it fails and what growth it drives. Consumers of that data provide inputs for the contracts that producer changes must pass.
- You will ensure Grab's data mesh is secure with proper access control and data classification.
- You will own Grab's data catalog, including lineage and the business context behind each table, and automate its upkeep.
- You will build in the open and do your own analysis through our agents.

- Data Architecture: You can trace data from Kafka through Spark or Flink jobs into the Iceberg tables analysts query in Trino, and spot where an upstream change quietly breaks a consumer even when the schema holds. You use that to challenge engineering designs.
- Data Trust: You have shipped data contracts, quality checks or incident workflows, tiered by business impact so higher tiers get stricter tests and faster fixes.
- Governance and Security: You have built access control or data classification into a data platform, for example tag-based policies or column masking. You can explain how an attacker would use an AI agent against it, and how you would stop them.

Job Description
About the Team:
The Robotics Technology team is a core part of Grab's long-term vision to build urban embodied AI. Our engineers take full ownership of the product lifecycle: designing and manufacturing hardware in-house, developing control and machine-learning systems, and rigorously testing in real-world conditions and production fleet operations. We are executing an ambitious growth plan to expand our robotics fleet across cities over the coming years, and we are focused on delivering highly productive, safe and efficient robot delivery services that help address current delivery labour shortages.
Based in Singapore and China, we offer opportunities to work on the latest autonomy, deploy solutions in complex environments, and directly influence the future of last-mile logistics. If you're excited by tangible impact, large-scale systems and cross-functional engineering, you'll find meaningful challenges and rapid career growth here.
Get to know the role
As a Senior Perception & Prediction Engineer, you will build and ship systems that turn raw multi-sensor data into a reliable, real-time and predictive representation of the world. You will work across a robust modular perception stack and modern learning-based approaches, contributing through model development, evaluation, debugging, integration and on-robot validation.
On top of a shipped multi-sensor detection baseline, you will deepen three connected capabilities: multi-object tracking, generic / open-set world understanding, and motion prediction. You will also help evaluate and productionise end-to-end temporal perception-prediction models and VLA / embodied foundation models for open-vocabulary understanding, long-tail reasoning and task-conditioned robot intelligence.
We are pragmatic about new research: a model earns its place through measurable closed-loop value, reliable grounding, real-time performance and safety. jobs.description:

Job Description
Get to Know the Team
The Streaming Data team (aka "Coban") strives to enable seamless and secure real-time access to the events or "streams", serving as Grab's unified, common access pattern for real-time data. The functional areas this team covers are streaming (Kafka), stream processing (Flink, Flink SQL, Kafka Connect), Change Data Capture, near real-time lake ingestion, stream exploration (Zeppelin, Flink SQL Gateway), and an in-house control plane for tenancy and resource management.
Some examples of the team's work are shared publicly on the Grab Engineering blog:
- Making Flink deployments safer through platform guardrails and production deployment patterns (Safer deployment of streaming applications).
- Improving Flink release confidence with shadow testing (Enhancing Flink deployment with shadow testing).
- Strengthening real-time Kafka data quality with syntactic and semantic stream contracts (Real-time data quality monitoring).
- Using machine learning to make Flink autoscaling more predictable and reliable (Machine-learning predictive autoscaling for Flink).
These are examples of the platform thinking this role will contribute to: turning complex real-time infrastructure problems into reliable, self-service capabilities for Grab teams.
Get to Know the Role
Here at Grab, we expect our Senior Engineers to significantly and autonomously contribute to their team, designing, shipping, operating, and monitoring software systems in a high-quality manner. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, your role would involve working on the systems within your team's domain. You would need to consider the appropriate architectural patterns, code design, and infrastructure options. Your goal is to ensure that you deliver a system that is secure, reliable, testable, maintainable, extensible, and well-tested.
You will work onsite at Grab Vietnam office (CMC Creative Space) in HCMC and report to Senior Data Engineering Manager, who is based in Singapore.

- In an agentic world, high-quality real-time signals are becoming even more critical to drive automation, decision-making, and measurable business impact.
- Apache Flink is a critical real-time infrastructure layer for Grab. By making stream processing easier, safer, and more self-serve, this role helps unlock more real-time signals and turn data into business value across Grab. As Grab embraces agentic engineering, we welcome builders with strong data infrastructure experience and a passion for stream processing to join us.

- Work with a team of engineers to make Stream Processing easy, reliable, efficient and secure across Grab, via self-served capabilities baked in our platform.
- Orchestrate and operate the Cloud infrastructure and Compute cluster that lays the foundation for the systems, maintaining the uptime for many critical services.
- Improve the automation and self-served capabilities that enable our small team to support 1000+ Stream Processing applications in Grab.
- Weigh in on design questions around platformization, infrastructure, observability and security.
- Contribute to the use of Stream Processing across Grab, by evangelizing for our platform and products, and by directly helping our internal users design and build the next game-changing real-time application for Grab.
- Create the abstractions, modules and libraries to lower the barrier of entry to Stream Processing in Grab and shift the maintenance and security toil away from our users.
- Participate in and evolve on-call and incident response procedures for the team.
Qualifications
What Essential Skills You Will Need
- 4+ years of experience in Kubernetes, Docker and Cloud infrastructure at scale.
- Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code like Terraform.
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines design and implementation
- Proficient with at least one programming language: Python, Golang, Java, Scala.
- Experience with Observability and Monitoring stack (LGTM, ELK, Datadog, or similar)
- Strong English communication skills, you will work together with peers and engineering teams across regional Tech offices.
- Experience with big-data systems is a big plus (especially Kafka and Flink)
- You are excited to learn and apply new technologies.

- Experience with AWS, Gitlab.
- Understanding of K8s networking concepts (service mesh, service discovery)
- Understanding of security concept and practices, secret managements, encryption, OAuth, RBAC/ABAC

The functional areas this team covers are streaming (Kafka), stream processing (Flink, Flink SQL, Kafka Connect), Change Data Capture, near real-time lake ingestion, stream exploration (Zeppelin, Flink SQL Gateway), and an in-house control plane for tenancy and resource management.
Some examples of the team's work are shared publicly on the Grab Engineering blog:
- Making Flink deployments safer through platform guardrails and production deployment patterns (Safer deployment of streaming applications).
- Improving Flink release confidence with shadow testing (Enhancing Flink deployment with shadow testing).
- Strengthening real-time Kafka data quality with syntactic and semantic stream contracts (Real-time data quality monitoring).
- Using machine learning to make Flink autoscaling more predictable and reliable (Machine-learning predictive autoscaling for Flink).
These are examples of the platform thinking this role will contribute to: turning complex real-time infrastructure problems into reliable, self-service capabilities for Grab teams.
Get to Know the Role
Here at Grab, we expect our Senior Engineers to significantly and autonomously contribute to their team, designing, shipping, operating, and monitoring software systems in a high-quality manner. As a Senior DevOps Engineer, your role would involve working on the systems within your team's domain. You would need to consider the appropriate architectural patterns, code design, and infrastructure options. Your goal is to ensure that you deliver a system that is secure, reliable, testable, maintainable, extensible, and well-tested.
You will work onsite at Grab Vietnam office (CMC Creative Space) in HCMC and report to Senior Data Engineering Manager, who is based in Singapore.
Why This Role Matters
- In an agentic world, high-quality real-time signals are becoming even more critical to drive automation, decision-making, and measurable business impact.
- Apache Flink is a critical real-time infrastructure layer for Grab. By making stream processing easier, safer, and more self-serve, this role helps unlock more real-time signals and turn data into business value across Grab. As Grab embraces agentic engineering, we welcome builders with strong data infrastructure experience and a passion for stream processing to join us.

- Work with a team of engineers to make Stream Processing easy, reliable, efficient and secure across Grab, via self-served capabilities baked in our platform.
- Orchestrate and operate the Cloud infrastructure and Compute cluster that lays the foundation for the systems, maintaining the uptime for many critical services.
- Improve the automation and self-served capabilities that enable our small team to support 1000+ Stream Processing applications in Grab.
- Weigh in on design questions around platformization, infrastructure, observability and security.
- Contribute to the use of Stream Processing across Grab, by evangelizing for our platform and products, and by directly helping our internal users design and build the next game-changing real-time application for Grab.
- Create the abstractions, modules and libraries to lower the barrier of entry to Stream Processing in Grab and shift the maintenance and security toil away from our users.
- Participate in and evolve on-call and incident response procedures for the team.
Qualifications

- 4+ years of experience in Kubernetes, Docker and Cloud infrastructure at scale.
- Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code like Terraform.
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines design and implementation
- Proficient with at least one programming language: Python, Golang, Java, Scala.

- Strong English communication skills, you will work together with peers and engineering teams across regional Tech offices.

jobs.description:
Company Description
About Grab and Our Workplace
Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.
Job Description
About the Team:
The Robotics Technology team is a core part of Grab's long-term vision to build urban embodied AI. Our engineers take full ownership of the product lifecycle: designing and manufacturing hardware in-house, developing control and machine-learning systems, and rigorously testing in real-world conditions and production fleet operations. This is a fast-moving, multidisciplinary environment where software, hardware and data science experts collaborate closely to solve practical challenges at scale. We are executing an ambitious growth plan to expand our robotics fleet across cities over the coming years, and we are focused on delivering highly productive, safe and efficient robot delivery services that help address current delivery labor shortages.
Based in Singapore and China, our team offers opportunities to work on cutting-edge autonomy, deploy solutions in complex urban environments, and directly influence the future of last-mile logistics. If you're excited by tangible impact, large-scale systems and cross-functional engineering, you'll find meaningful challenges and rapid career growth here.
Get to know the Role:
We are looking for a Data Infrastructure Engineer to own the data backbone of our robotics programme. Our fleet produces a large, continuous and unforgiving stream of data — sensor recordings, telemetry, autonomy events, and operational and delivery records — and almost every decision the team makes depends on that data arriving complete, on time and demonstrably correct. You will own the pipelines that move it, the validation and monitoring that prove it is trustworthy, the dashboards that engineering, operations and data science work from, and the integration of our robotics data and ML workloads onto Grab's existing data and ML platforms, so the team inherits Grab-scale tooling instead of rebuilding it. This is an ownership role over an established and growing footprint: you will take on existing pipelines, raise their reliability, and shape where the platform goes next.
The day-to-day activities
- Design, build and operate batch and streaming pipelines for robot telemetry, sensor recordings, autonomy events and operational data.
- Implement data quality and validation frameworks — schema enforcement, completeness and freshness checks, anomaly detection — with meaningful alerting when data breaks.
- Build observability for the pipelines themselves: throughput, lag, cost, failure modes and clear on-call signals.
- Build and maintain dashboards and curated, self-serve datasets for engineering, data science and fleet operations.
- Integrate robotics data and ML workloads onto Grab's central data and ML platforms — lakehouse, orchestration, feature and model tooling — rather than maintaining parallel stacks.
- Design storage, indexing and retention for high-volume sensor data (ROS 2 / MCAP recordings, video, point clouds), balancing accessibility against cost.
- Partner with autonomy, perception and ML engineers to define metrics, and make training and evaluation datasets reproducible and versioned.
- Own data access, governance, retention and compliance across the regions we operate in.
- Drive down platform cost through partitioning, storage tiering, lifecycle policies and compute right-sizing.
- Document pipelines and datasets so that consumers can self-serve without a hand-off conversation.
If you want your work measured by whether engineers and data scientists can trust and reach their data, and you enjoy making a data platform boringly reliable, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with your resume and a brief note describing a data quality or pipeline reliability problem you owned: how you detected it, what you changed, and how you knew it stayed fixed.
Qualifications
Technical must-haves
- Strong Python and SQL, with the ability to write production-grade data services rather than one-off scripts.
- Hands-on experience building and operating both batch and streaming pipelines (Spark, Flink, Kafka or equivalents).
- Workflow orchestration at production scale (Airflow, Dagster, Argo Workflows or similar).
- Data warehouse and lakehouse experience: open table formats (Iceberg, Delta, Hudi), partitioning strategy, and query engines (Presto/Trino, Spark SQL, BigQuery or equivalent).
- Demonstrated ownership of data quality: validation frameworks, data contracts, tests, and alerting on the data itself — not only on job success.
- Experience with observability and dashboarding tooling (Prometheus/Grafana, Superset, Tableau or similar).
- Cloud engineering on Alibaba Cloud (Aliyun) and/or AWS, including object storage at scale, with Terraform as the primary IaC tool.
- Docker and Kubernetes for building and running data workloads.
- Solid cost awareness: able to reason about storage tiering, egress and compute trade-offs and act on them.
Soft skills must-haves
- Strong ownership; treats data correctness as a product commitment rather than a ticket queue.
- Clear communicator who can turn a vague analytical question into a concrete dataset or metric definition.
- Collaborative across autonomy, ML, backend and operations teams.
- Pragmatic prioritization: knows when to ship a pipeline and when to fix the foundation underneath it.
- Comfortable inheriting, understanding and improving existing systems, not only greenfield builds.
- Willingness to be on-call for data platform issues.
Nice-to-haves
- Experience with robotics or vehicle data: ROS 2 bags, MCAP, time-series sensor data and geospatial data.
- Familiarity with visualization tooling for robotics data (Foxglove or similar).
- ML platform experience: feature stores, training pipelines, experiment tracking and model registries (Kubeflow, MLflow or equivalent).
- Experience with large-scale multimedia data (camera, lidar) indexing and retrieval.
- Exposure to simulation-generated datasets — we primarily use CARLA and NVIDIA Isaac Sim.
- Experience operating data infrastructure across multiple regions, including cross-border data constraints.
- Experience working across APAC sites or with distributed, cross-border teams.
Additional Information

- We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.

jobs.description:

About the Team:
The Robotics Technology team is a core part of Grab's long-term vision to build urban embodied AI. Our engineers take full ownership of the product lifecycle: designing and manufacturing hardware in-house, developing control and machine-learning systems, and rigorously testing in real-world conditions and production fleet operations. This is a fast-moving, multidisciplinary environment where software, hardware and data science experts collaborate closely to solve practical challenges at scale. We are executing an ambitious growth plan to expand our robotics fleet across cities over the coming years, and we are focused on delivering highly productive, safe and efficient robot delivery services that help address current delivery labor shortages.
Based in Singapore and China, our team offers opportunities to work on cutting-edge autonomy, deploy solutions in complex urban environments, and directly influence the future of last-mile logistics. If you're excited by tangible impact, large-scale systems and cross-functional engineering, you'll find meaningful challenges and rapid career growth here.
Get to know the Role:
We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to own the engineering environments our robotics team builds on — cloud, developer workstations, and the robots themselves. Our software runs on ARM64 computers on a moving vehicle, is developed and run on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows, and is built and operated from two engineering sites with different network and cloud constraints. Your job is to make those environments consistent, reproducible and fast, so that an engineer at either site gets the same toolchain, the same build and the same behaviour on the robot. This is a broad, high-leverage role with a large surface area and a lot of latitude: you will set the standards, build the automation behind them, and take real ownership of a platform that is growing quickly alongside the fleet.
The day-to-day activities
- Own and evolve developer environment tooling across Ubuntu, macOS and Windows — reproducible, declarative and version-controlled setups rather than wiki instructions.
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for cloud services, backend systems and cross-compiled embedded/robot software, including ARM64 targets.
- Own container image and artifact strategy: registries, base images, caching, provenance and promotion between environments.
- Manage the on-robot software environment: OS images, system packages, dependency pinning, and safe rollout and rollback of host-level changes.
- Build and operate cloud environments and Infrastructure as Code across regions, including networking, identity and access management.
- Standardize and unify toolchains and environments across our engineering sites, while respecting the constraints that genuinely differ between regions.
- Evaluate, specify and support developer and compute hardware — workstations, GPUs, test rigs and onboard compute — and own the lifecycle around it.
- Automate what is currently manual: provisioning, onboarding, credential rotation, environment refreshes and routine operational tasks.
- Improve build and test speed, and treat engineer wait time as a first-class metric.
- Write and maintain runbooks and internal documentation, and coach engineers so that platform knowledge is shared rather than concentrated.
Qualifications
Technical must-haves
- Deep Linux (Ubuntu) systems knowledge: packaging, systemd, networking, storage, and troubleshooting from kernel to userspace.
- Practical experience managing macOS and Windows developer environments alongside Linux.
- Configuration management and reproducible environments (Ansible, Nix, Chef/Puppet, devcontainers or equivalent).
- Strong CI/CD engineering with GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions or similar, including cross-compilation and multi-architecture builds.
- Docker and Kubernetes in production, plus artifact and registry management (Artifactory, Harbor or equivalent).
- Cloud engineering on Alibaba Cloud (Aliyun) and/or AWS with Terraform as the primary IaC tool.
- Strong scripting and automation skills in Python and Bash; Go is a plus.
- Solid networking and security fundamentals: VPNs and overlay networks, DNS, TLS/PKI, IAM and secret management.
- Experience supporting build systems for compiled software (CMake, Bazel, colcon or similar).
- Comfortable being on-call and supporting engineers and field sites across time zones.
Soft skills must-haves
- Strong ownership and bias for action; picks up the unglamorous work that unblocks everyone else.
- Service mindset: treats internal engineers as customers and measures success by their productivity.
- Excellent prioritization across a wide surface area — knows what to automate, what to defer and what to decline.
- Clear communicator and documenter who builds systems other people can operate.
- Collaborative across software, hardware, ML and operations teams.
- Comfortable working across two sites and cultures, and able to standardize without steamrolling legitimate local needs.
Nice-to-haves
- Experience with ROS/ROS2 build and packaging (colcon, bloom, .deb pipelines, apt repositories).
- Embedded or edge fleet management: OTA update systems, device provisioning and remote access (balena, Mender, KubeEdge or equivalent).
- Experience with ARM64 and NVIDIA Jetson or comparable edge compute platforms.
- Endpoint management and compliance tooling (Jamf, Intune or equivalent) in an engineering context.
- Experience with hardware-in-the-loop rigs and lab infrastructure.
- Experience operating infrastructure across multiple regions, including cross-border network and compliance constraints.
- Experience working across APAC sites or with distributed, cross-border teams.
If you like owning the whole toolchain — from the laptop an engineer opens in the morning to the image running on a robot that afternoon — and you want the mandate to make it coherent, we'd love to hear from you. Please apply with your resume and a brief note describing a developer environment or build system you standardized: what was inconsistent before, what you changed, and what it saved.
Additional Information
Life at Grab
We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
- We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
- With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
- Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
- We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges
- Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours
What we stand for at Grab
We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

Company Description
About Grab and our workplace

jobs.description:
Company Description
About Grab and Our Workplace

Job Description
Get to Know the Team
The GrabFood Analytics team is part of ACE Analytics, which covers GrabFood, GrabMart, GrabExpress and OmniCommerce. We are the product analytics partners to the GrabFood product organisation across six Southeast Asian markets. Each analyst owns one or two product problem spaces end-to-end. They define the metrics that matter, design and read the experiments behind every launch, and run the deep dives that decide what gets built next. We work AI-first: analysts build and share reusable AI workflows that take on the repetitive parts of the job, so our time goes to judgement and product thinking. This is a new seat, created to take on additional product problem spaces.
Get to Know the Role
Reporting to the Senior Analytics Manager, you will be the analytics owner. You will also be the advisor for one to two GrabFood product problem spaces. These problem spaces may include, for example, ordering experience and conversion, merchant discovery and content, delivery reliability and demand shaping, or affordability and promotions. You will work directly with the product manager, designers, engineers and data scientists for that space, most of whom are based in Singapore, and with country teams across the region.
This is a senior individual-contributor role. You set the metrics. You design an experiment and read it. You make the ship, iterate or stop recommendation and hold it when the data says so. You decide what to prioritise when several partners need you in the same week.
This is a product analytics role, not a machine-learning role: your time goes to metrics, experiments, root-cause analysis and product decisions, not to model building.
We base this role in Petaling Jaya and will require you to work onsite.
The Critical Tasks You Will Perform
- You will define the metrics for your problem space: the primary metric at the exact step a feature changes, the leading and lagging indicators around it, and the guardrails that catch the failure modes.
- You will design and analyse controlled experiments with your product manager: hypothesis, randomisation unit, success metric, sample size and duration, guardrails, and the checks that keep a result honest. You will turn results into a clear ship, iterate or stop recommendation.
- You will diagnose metric movements systematically. This will involve, locating the movement, decomposing it, cutting it by funnel step, segment, platform, and market. After that, ruling out tracking and data-quality causes. Finally, explaining it why.
- You will size opportunities and run proactive deep dives into consumer, merchant and driver-partner behaviour that shape the roadmap rather than report on it.
- You will oversee the data specifications and instrumentation for new features with engineering, so the data exists to measure what you planned to measure.
- You will build the dashboards and certified metrics that give the product team reliable self-serve visibility.
- You will build AI-assisted analytics workflows for yourself and the team, validated against raw data and business logic, and share what works.
- You will improve on experimentation and analytical rigour across the problem spaces you touch, and coach junior analysts as the team grows.
Qualifications
What Essential Skills You Will Need
- At least 4 years in analytics or quantitative roles, with at least 2 years of experience where you owned the metrics for a consumer product, growth, pricing, CRM, or marketing programme. Experience in data analytics is a bonus. It is especially valuable in industries such as food or grocery delivery and e-commerce marketplaces. It is also valuable in ride-hailing and super-apps, e-wallets and digital banking, travel, telco digital products, and consumer FinTech.
- Fluent SQL on large datasets, and proficient Python or R for analysis.
- Hands-on experience designing and analysing controlled experiments: A/B tests, holdouts, or well-designed quasi-experiments such as difference-in-differences or synthetic control where randomisation was not possible. You can explain why you chose the design, what could bias it, and how you read a result that is not clean.
- Sound statistics applied to decisions: hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, sample size and power, multiple comparisons, selection bias and mix shifts. You can explain these in plain language to a product manager, and you know when a method breaks.
- Precise metric framing: You can define the right metric for a change. This includes specifying its numerator, denominator, and the population it is measured on. Additionally, you can distinguish a feature-engagement metric from a conversion metric.
- Structured solutioning on ambiguous questions: You lay out the space before you commit to a hypothesis, and you can write the analysis plan before you open a notebook.
- Manage partner trade-offs: You set priorities across competing asks, say no with reasons, and keep quality on what you ship. You close your own knowledge gaps quickly and act on feedback.
- Clear communication: you make the finding and the decision clear to product leaders and engineers alike, in writing and live.
- You use AI tools in your supervised analytics workflow, validating output against raw data and business logic.
- At least a Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, Analytics or another quantitative field.
What Would Be Good to Have
- Experience in food delivery, marketplaces or super-apps across Southeast Asian markets.
- Experience with an experimentation platform, or having built experiment analysis tooling.
- Causal inference methods beyond A/B testing.
- Dashboarding in tools like Tableau, Superset or PowerBI; build data pipelines.
- Have built a reusable AI workflow, skill or agent that your team adopted.
- Coach analysts.
