jobs.title: Backend Engineer Manager (Bangkok based, Relocation provided)
jobs.description:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get to Know our Team:
In Agoda’s Back End Engineering department, we build the scalable, fault-tolerant systems and APIs that host our core business logic. Our systems cover all major areas of our business: inventory and pricing, product information, customer data, communications, partner data, booking systems, payments, and more. These mission-critical systems change frequently with dozens of releases per day, so we must employ state-of-the-art CI/CD and testing techniques in order to make sure everything works without any downtime. We also ensure that our systems are self-healing, responding gracefully to extreme loads or unexpected input. In order to accomplish this, we use state-of-the-art languages like Scala and Go, data technologies like Kafka and Aerospike, and agile development practices. Most importantly though, we hire great people from all around the world and empower them to be successful. Whether it’s building new projects like Flights and Packages or reimagining our existing business, you’ll make a big impact as part of the Back End Engineering team.
The Opportunity:
The Engineering Manager role at Agoda is one of the most significant and challenging roles at the company. The right candidate is both extremely hands on – technically excellent, with solid engineering principles – and exhibits strong leadership and people development skills. We are looking for world class development managers to lead one or more of our engineering teams.
In this Role, you'll get to:
- Be hands on - its one of the job’s fundamental task, and most of our development managers are writing and reviewing code, giving expert level coaching and guidance to their engineers.
- It's important to have a love of engineering and a passion for building things elegantly and at scale. Staying in touch with where the industry is going is crucial, and it’s important to have strong opinions about how systems should be architected, engineered, and maintained.
- Do full stack engineering: you should have solid experience in all parts of the technology stack: infrastructure, client side, back end, performance, data, and others.
- Developing people - Despite our investment and belief in technology, people are still our greatest asset. The right candidate will have a keen interest in developing people: inspiring those around them so they can achieve their potential. Being able to bring A-players such as yourself from outside and integrating them into the business will also be important.
What you'll Need to Succeed:
- Extremely proficient in at least 1 programming language (Java, Scala, C#)
- Strong experience in systems architecture – particularly in complex, scalable and fault tolerant distributed systems
- Demonstrable experience as a system owner with operational responsibility
- Proficient in lower level engineering (Garbage collection, context switching, threading)
- DevOps culture – Agility. Leanness. Automation. CI/CD
- Good understanding of application security
- Passionate about technology and the Internet
- Must have worked in a successful agile development team
- Must have run engineering teams before with 5+ direct reports
- Able to operate with autonomously: making decisions, setting KPIs, with a strong sense of ownership
- Practices data driven decision making
It's Great if you have:
- Proficiency in more than one programming language

You'll combine hands-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.

- Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
- Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end-to-end, within your service or team

- Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team

Technical

- Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
- Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs & system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
- Strong coding and problem-solving ability

- Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
- Experience communicating trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly

As a Senior BI Developer, you will be a key individual contributor building trusted data
products for Agoda’s technology organization, including curated datasets, metrics,
dashboards and visualizations, and scalable data transformations. You will work closely
with engineers, engineering managers, team leads, and senior leadership to help the
organization make better decisions with data. This role combines analytics, metrics
definition, and stakeholder consulting with hands-on data engineering and development
IN THIS ROLE, YOU’LL GET TO
• Act as a partner and consultant to engineering managers and leaders: translate
stakeholder and engineering questions into measurable metrics/information such
as developer velocity, cost efficiency, and code quality, and keep those definitions
consistent across reports.
• Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT transformations, including Spark/Python
workflows and warehouse models, so data is accurate, timely, tested, and fit for
reporting. As a Senior, review others’ pipeline and metric work, raise delivery
standards, and unblock the team.
• Analyze large datasets with SQL and Python to support engineering and operational
decisions.
• Design and maintain dashboards and visual reports so engineering managers and
leaders can explore metrics (for example developer velocity, cost efficiency, and
code quality) without a ticket for every chart.
• Improve data reliability through validation, quality checks, observability, production
troubleshooting, and query performance tuning. Own published metrics: explain
filters and grain, flag numbers that should not be trusted, and recommend next
steps.
• Use AI tools (for example Cursor, Claude, or similar) to accelerate SQL
development, testing, refactoring, analysis, pipeline work, and documentation, and
reject unsafe or unverified output before it reaches production or stakeholders.
WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED
• 5+ years in business intelligence, analytics, and/or data engineering, with
experience in both stakeholder consulting and hands-on pipeline or data-product
work.
• Advanced SQL (joins, window functions, and performance on large datasets).
• Strong Python skills (or similar) for building data pipelines.
• Experience with ETL/ELT and orchestration (for example Kubeflow or similar).
• Strong analytical thinking: comfortable framing business questions, exploring data,
and turning results into clear insights.
• Experience building dashboards or visual reports for stakeholders.
• Ability to switch context between stakeholder discussions and hands-on technical
work — metrics definition/analysis one day, ETL or data modeling the next.
• Practical AI-assisted development: generate, review, test, and own the result. You
can explain what you trusted AI to draft and what you verified yourself.
• Clear written and verbal English, and the ability to work independently with
engineers and leaders in an agile environment.
IT’S GREAT IF YOU HAVE
• Experience with software-delivery practices such as Agile/Scrum and CI/CD
(GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar).
• Interest in developer productivity or engineering analytics.
• Experience with common data platforms / big data technology (e.g., BigQuery,
Snowflake, Redshift, Hive, Spark, Vertica, StarRocks, or similar).
• Hands-on experience with visualization or data-serving UIs such as Apache
Superset, Tableau, or a lightweight web app.
• Experience building APIs or internal data products beyond dashboards, not only ad-
hoc analysis.
• A degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent
practical experience.

Planning a trip can feel like a second job. Agodaʼs AI Assistant turns a loose travel idea into a personalized, actionable trip plan across hotels, flights, and activities. Weʼre hiring Lead/Principal Data Scientists to own how it understands, plans, recommends, and improves.
Get To Know Our Team
Youʼll join the team building Agodaʼs AI Assistant: The assistant runs on Agodaʼs live inventory of 6M+ properties, 130K+ flight routes and 300K+ activities, so your work can directly shape the options and decisions travelers see in live booking journeys. Weʼre early enough that the big design decisions are still open, and youʼll make many of them. The role suits senior data scientists and ML practitioners who want end-to-end responsibility for complex systems, where ML, product and engineering meet
What You'll Do
- Own the assistantʼs core intelligence: intent understanding, multi-step trip planning,
memory, and tool calls into Agodaʼs search.
- Build the evaluation backbone: offline evaluations, LLM-as-judge calibrated against
human labels, and A/B tests, so we know a change is better before travelers see it.
- Make the hard trade-offs with data: use data to make hard trade-offs among quality,
latency, cost, and reliability, in partnership with product, engineering, and leadership.
- Ship, learn, repeat: get ideas into production fast and let usage tell you what to fix next.
- Raise the bar: set technical direction and DS practices for building and evaluating agents,
and mentor other data scientists
What We're Looking For
- Strong DS fundamentals: Modeling, statistics, experimentation and causal inference.
- Hands-on experience building LLM systems: RAG, tool use, agent orchestration, context
and memory, with an evaluation-first approach.
- Problem-solving mindset: Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with comfort
operating in open-ended problem spaces where requirements evolve.
- Deep LLM experience is valuable: but exceptional DS/ML depth, strong product judgment,
and the ability to ramp quickly are equally important.
Why This Role
- Meaningful user impact: Help millions of travelers make better, more confident decisions
for trips that matter to them.
- High ownership, high impact: Your work will shape a customer-facing system operating in
real travel and booking journeys.
- Direct influence: Play a key role in both implementation and product direction.
Nice to Have
- Experience in online travel, e-commerce, search, ranking, recommendations, pricing, or personalization.
- Experience with production LLM or generative-AI systems.
- Advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Mathematics, or a related field.
If youʼre excited about building real-world AI products at scale and owning systems that directly impact millions of travelers, weʼd love to hear from you!

DevOps Engineering team is tasked with creating automation into the Software Development Lifecycle concerning all Agoda’s R&D. The team is responsible for maintaining all central Dev-related tooling chain and develop internal tools/Web Portals in order to increase development efficiency and security. The impact of this engineering team affects all development in Agoda.

- Bridging the gap between Development and Operations
- Full-stack development for internal portals and tooling
- Developing people – Despite our investment and belief in technology, people are still our greatest asset. The right candidate will have a keen interest in developing people: inspiring those around them so they can achieve their potential. Being able to bring A-players such as yourself from outside and integrating them into the business will also be important.

- Hands-on experience with the whole SDLC: Requirement, Design, Code, Test, Deploy
- Must have run engineering teams before with 5+ direct reports

jobs.title: [Infra] Staff/Lead Software Engineer – Compute Platform (Bangkok Based, relocation provided)
jobs.description:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get to Know our Team
The Compute Platform team operates the fleet of bare metal and virtual machines infrastructure that every product at Agoda runs on. As part of the team, you will be contributing to a mission-critical private cloud with over one million cores, spread across hundreds of Kubernetes clusters, OpenStack virtual machines, and bare metal servers across our global data centers.
A core part of the team's roadmap is ACP (Agoda Compute Platform), our in-house, lightweight orchestration stack for dedicated-resource virtual machines on bare metal, alongside broader fleet lifecycle tooling and automation.
The Opportunity
Our Compute Platform team in Bangkok is looking for an experienced Staff/Lead Software Engineer to take technical ownership of ACP and our wider fleet and compute platform. You will be a senior, hands-on individual contributor: someone who can independently design, build, and drive the architecture of large-scale infrastructure systems, while mentoring other engineers and representing the team as a technical point of contact across Agoda's engineering organization.
In This Role, You'll Get to:
- Own and evolve the architecture of ACP: the orchestrator, per-host agent, and CLI that manage dedicated-resource virtual machines on bare metal, including compute placement, image management, and network recovery.
- Design, build, and operate Agoda's compute and fleet tooling in Go (and Python where relevant), including systems that interface with Kubernetes, OpenStack, and out-of-band hardware management APIs.
- Lead medium to large projects across Fleet, Compute Platform, and adjacent teams, with ownership from design through delivery and operation.
- Take an active role in System Design Reviews, both within the team and across the wider engineering organization, influencing architecture beyond your own systems.
- Use agentic coding tools (for example Claude Code and similar) as a normal part of design, implementation, testing, and review — the way the team works today — and help others use them well without lowering engineering standards.
- Troubleshoot product and system issues at scale across multiple global data centers.
- Interview and mentor engineers across the team and help raise the hiring bar for compute and fleet roles.
- Define and use clear measures for ACP reliability, operational load, and delivery quality, and use them to decide what to build next.
- Work with Software Development, Infrastructure Management, and adjacent teams to gather requirements and design scalable, resilient services.
- Write the technical documentation and training the team needs to operate and extend ACP.
What You'll Need to Succeed:
- 10+ years of software engineering, with a strong hands-on background in infrastructure or compute systems (bare metal, virtualization, Kubernetes, and/or OpenStack).
- Strong distributed systems development skills in Go; Python is advantageous.
- Proven experience owning and evolving distributed systems such as control planes, orchestrators, or agents in production.
- Experience with virtualization and bare-metal provisioning at scale.
- Practical experience using Kubernetes in production (workloads, APIs, and how clusters actually behave).
- Comfortable using agentic coding tools in day-to-day software development, or able to adopt the team’s workflow quickly. These tools are how we work; they are not a substitute for distributed-systems judgment, code quality, or operational ownership.
- Strong understanding of observability for distributed systems: monitoring, alerting, logging, and visualisation at scale.
- A track record of leading medium to large technical projects and driving architectural decisions inside a team.
- Experience working across team boundaries and learning the internals of adjacent systems, not only your own.
- Clear written and verbal English, including design docs, reviews, and cross-team discussion.
It's Great if You Have:
- Hands-on experience with Kubernetes beyond cluster-user work: controllers, operators, and/or CRDs.
- Experience contributing to or maintaining open-source Kubernetes Operators/Controllers.
- Experience with configuration management and automation tooling, preferably Ansible and/or AWX.
- Experience with out-of-band hardware management APIs (iLO, DRAC) and physical architecture at scale, including building resilient, highly available solutions with no single point of failure.

jobs.title: Junior Application Specialist - Salesforce Developer, Strategic Partnerships (Bangkok-based, Relocation Provided)
jobs.description:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get To Know Our Team:
Strategic Partnerships is a team of creative entrepreneurs that develop solutions for Agoda’s non-accommodation partners and promote Agoda’s top and bottom-line growth. We design tailored business and product solutions with our partners and help them generate measurable value. Members of our team are empowered and supported to grow their market(s) or accounts. We develop win-win relationships and leverage Agoda’s unique accommodations portfolio and tech solutions to bring our partners the advantages they seek.  Utilizing our strong brand and resources, we build new channels to increase the visibility of Agoda, introduce more travelers to our great products and service and deliver significant revenues to the overall business.
The Opportunity:
The Junior Application Specialist - Salesforce is responsible for maintaining existing Salesforce functionality (SalesCloud, ServiceCloud, and ExperienceCloud) and assuring user satisfaction and adoption. The role sits at the intersection of business process design, Salesforce configuration, integrations, stakeholder management, and user adoption. You will assist with designing, developing, and implementing new Salesforce features across the commercial organization.
The team needs a specialist who can bridge day-to-day Salesforce execution with broader business needs: implementing features, improving process efficiency, supporting data quality, and enabling adoption. A Junior Salesforce Application Specialist is deeply committed to solving user (customer, provider, and internal users) pain points and identifying opportunities to improve their experience.
In practice, this role is most valuable when the team needs someone who can own medium-complexity Salesforce problems end-to-end, keep stakeholders aligned, and make the platform easier to use and more scalable over time.
What You’ll Do:
-
User Experience & Adoption: Maintain existing Salesforce tooling, ensure user satisfaction, and champion continuous improvements in UI/UX (Lightning App Builder, page layouts, dynamic forms). Support end users through training, user assistance, and issue resolution.
-
Core Administration & Scalability: Perform system administration including user management (profiles and roles), validation rules, Lightning Flows, record types, and mobile setup. Stay current with Salesforce seasonal releases and recommend new features.
-
Implement Salesforce features with a focus on automation and efficiency using Flows, standard OOTB automations, and where needed APEX/Javascript.
-
Release & Change Management: Support release management (sandbox refreshes, deployment planning, UAT coordination) and document changes and configurations.
-
Security & Health Checks: Review data security, sharing rules, and ensure GDPR compliance. Monitor system performance, storage usage, and manage data backup systems (e.g., OwnBACKUP).
-
Reporting: Create and maintain reports, dashboards, and Salesforce data quality to support operational visibility.
Required Qualifications:
-
1-3 years of hands-on Salesforce experience for the Application Specialist role
-
Strong knowledge of Salesforce best practices, administration, and platform functionality.
-
Experience designing and implementing new processes and improving user adoption.
-
Understanding of relational databases, integrations, and source-to-target data mappings.
-
Familiarity with agile development practices, tools, and frameworks.
-
Strong analytical thinking, structured problem solving, and the ability to articulate complex requirements clearly.
-
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a collaborative working style.
Preferred Qualifications:
-
Experience working across both configuration and light technical implementation, rather than purely declarative administration.
-
Exposure to APIs, service-oriented architecture, and collaboration with non-Salesforce engineering teams.
-
Evidence of ownership beyond ticket execution, including documentation, stakeholder follow-through, and improving the operating model around the platform.
-
Salesforce Administrator, Sales Cloud or Service Cloud certification is a plus

- Meaningful user impact: Help millions of travelers make better, more confident decisions

real travel and booking journeys.

- Advanced degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Operations Research, Mathematics, or a related field.

jobs.title: Lead DevOps Engineer (Bangkok based, Relocation provided)
jobs.description:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get To Know Our Team:
The Data department oversees all Agoda’s data-related requirements. Our goal is to enable and increase the use of data in the company through creative approaches and the implementation of powerful resources such as operational and analytical databases, queue systems, BI tools, and data science technology. We hire the brightest minds from around the world to take on this challenge and equip them with the knowledge and tools that contribute to their personal growth and success while supporting our company’s culture of diversity and experimentation. The role the Data team plays at Agoda is critical as business users, product managers, engineers, and many others rely on us to empower their decision making. We are equally dedicated to our customers by improving their search experience with faster results and protecting them from any fraudulent activities. Data is interesting only when you have enough of it, and we have plenty. This is what drives up the challenge as part of the Data department, but also the reward.
The Opportunity:
As a Lead Engineer (IC5), you will define the vision, architecture, and multi-year technical roadmap for our DevOps, automation, and platform engineering initiatives across the Data department. You are expected to operate as a subject matter expert and strategic technical leader, driving foundational improvements in infrastructure scalability, developer velocity, release engineering, and system reliability. In this high-impact role, you will solve complex, ambiguous engineering challenges across multi-region hybrid infrastructure, champion modern Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) and GitOps practices, and partner closely with engineering directors, principal architects, QA leads, and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure our platform capabilities proactively align with long-term business growth.
What You’ll Do:
- Architect, scale, and lead the technical vision for hybrid infrastructure orchestration and automation across multi-cloud and on-premises environments, prioritizing resilience, operational efficiency, and cost optimization.
- Spearhead departmental adoption of DevOps, SRE, and GitOps methodologies, driving engineering transformation across development, platform, and QA teams to accelerate release velocity and minimize blast radius.
- Establish architectural standards and lead design reviews for large-scale automation frameworks, CI/CD platforms, and core infrastructure services to ensure robust security, high availability, and compliance.
- Define and execute the strategic technical roadmap for DevOps and developer productivity, identifying enterprise-wide bottlenecks and implementing automated solutions for highly ambiguous operational challenges.
- Diagnose and resolve systemic high-severity incidents, performance bottlenecks, and architectural trade-offs within complex distributed data pipelines and cloud infrastructure.
- Mentor senior and mid-level engineers, cultivate a culture of engineering excellence, and raise the bar for technical design, code quality, and operational readiness.
- Evaluate, prototype, and implement emerging platform technologies, service meshes, and observability tooling to continuously advance our core operational infrastructure.
- Establish best-in-class operational playbooks, architecture patterns, and technical governance, influencing engineering standards across the wider organization.
Required Qualifications:
- Advanced software engineering mastery in one or more core languages (e.g., Golang, Python, Java) with a track record of architecting scalable, maintainable enterprise software systems.
- Proven track record as a lead contributor designing, optimizing, and modernizing the end-to-end Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) and developer infrastructure for large-scale engineering organizations.
- Deep theoretical and practical foundation in distributed systems, network fundamentals, storage engine architecture, and high-concurrency systems design.
- Subject matter expertise in containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes, Helm, custom operators), including multi-tenant cluster management, security hardening, and performance tuning at scale.
- Hands-on experience implementing enterprise Service Mesh and Service Discovery solutions (e.g., Istio, Linkerd, Consul, Envoy) for traffic management, mTLS security, and observability in large-scale cluster environments.
- Demonstrated technical leadership in driving major cross-functional infrastructure initiatives, aligning multiple technical teams, and delivering impactful outcomes on tight timelines.
- Exceptional troubleshooting capabilities with hands-on experience conducting deep-dive root cause analysis across distributed microservices, network fabrics, and kernel/OS-level issues.
- Proven capability to act as a technical mentor and force multiplier, establishing engineering guidelines, conducting RFC reviews, and growing technical talent.
- Deep expertise in SRE principles, continuous delivery patterns, Infrastructure as Code, and driving continuous improvement in system SLOs and error budgets.
- Superior technical communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to articulate architectural decisions clearly to executive leadership and technical staff alike.
- Deep expertise in architecting, scaling, and operating enterprise-grade relational and non-relational database infrastructure (e.g., PostgreSQL, MSSQL), encompassing schema optimization, zero-downtime migrations, failover strategies, and high-availability replication topologies.
- Proven leadership in designing and championing automated, zero-downtime continuous deployment platforms using GitOps methodologies (e.g., ArgoCD, Flux) and progressive release strategies (Canary, Blue/Green, automated rollback mechanisms).
Preferred Qualifications:
- Proven track record of architecting, deploying, and operating multi-region, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant distributed systems in mission-critical production environments.
- Extensive background in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management frameworks (e.g., Terraform, OpenTofu, Ansible, Pulumi) for declarative platform provisioning.
- Expertise in full-stack observability and SRE tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, Datadog, ELK/OpenSearch), including defining actionable metrics, tracing, and automated alerting.
- Experience with major cloud service providers (GCP, AWS, Azure), multi-cloud architectures, and financial operations (FinOps) to manage cloud utilization efficiently.

About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get to Know Our Team
Fintech is one of the fastest growing areas in Agoda and we are rapidly expanding our tech team. We work closely with the finance business team and our Fintech product owners to reduce risk, drive efficiencies and move on new market opportunities in this exciting field. We have a wide range of projects from traditional finance to cutting-edge customer fintech. For example, reconciliation using Big Data technologies, growing and optimizing customer payments options, tax calculations in milli-second response times and a mesh of supplier payment options like virtual credit cards. It’s a hot field and the perfect mix of data engineering and backend engineering.
The Opportunity
In this role, you will not only develop robust backend systems but also architect and maintain scalable data pipelines and storage solutions that support complex data collection, processing, and analysis. Your dual expertise in backend and data engineering will play a crucial role in optimizing our financial technology solutions and driving informed business decisions through reliable data insights.
In This Role, You’ll Get to
- Think and own the full life cycle of our products, not just a single piece of code – from business requirements, technology selection, coding standards, agile development, unit and application testing, to CI/CD and proper monitoring
- Design, develop and maintain platforms and data pipelines across fintech
- Boost System Performance: build systems that are stable, scalable, and highly performant to meet the dynamic demands of the financial landscape
- Write great code and help others write great code – mentor people in your team and wider
- Collaborate with other teams and departments
- Exceptional problem-solving skills coupled with a strategic mindset are essential. You possess the ability to adapt to new changes and the foresight to anticipate future needs. Leadership at Agoda isn’t just managing tasks but inspiring innovation and driving vision into reality.
- Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration: work with diverse teams to drive forward product and technology goals
- Shape our future team: Play a pivotal role in recruiting and onboarding exceptional talent
What You’ll Need to Succeed
- 10+ years of experience with strong proficiency in Java, Kotlin, Scala, or C# with a proven track record of developing high-performance applications in production settings. Insightful experience with big data technologies like Hadoop, real-time processing frameworks (e.g., Apache Spark), and advanced knowledge of SQL and data architecture.
- Thinks in systems: their edge cases, failure modes, and life cycles
- Uses a metrics driven approach and can make informed decisions using data
- You are passionate about the craft of software development and constantly work to improve your knowledge and skills
- Experience with Scrum/Agile development methodologies
- Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
- Experience with operational excellence and a deep understanding of metrics, alarms and dashboards
It’s Great If You Have
- Experience working in a modern FinTech or Payments organization
- Domain knowledge in any of these areas: financial reconciliation, financial reporting, tax, payout methods like virtual credit cards or customer payments
- Hands-on experience working with technologies like Spark for data processing, ETLs for data pipelines and queueing systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
- Core engineering infrastructure tools like GitLab for source control and Continuous Integration, Kubernetes
- Experience developing, maintaining and debugging large-scale distributed systems
- Experience in leading projects, initiatives and/or teams, with full ownership of the systems involved
This position is based in Bangkok, Thailand. (Relocation package is provided)

This role will be part of the People Help Desk team, supporting Level 1 service requests from Agodans. The successful candidate will have an opportunity to gain hands-on experience across a wide range of HR domains and help enhance our service desk.
- Be the first point of contact for People-related inquiries and requests across multiple channels (email, chat, Zendesk, self-service, automations).
- Gain hands-on exposure across People/HR domains (e.g., HRIS data, onboarding, benefits, time & attendance, mobility, policies, general inquiries).
- Contribute to a service culture that balances speed, accuracy, and empathy to improve the day-to-day experience of Agodans.
In This Role, You’ll Get To
- Provide clear, timely Tier 1 resolutions; triage and escalate to Tier 2 when appropriate.
- Manage the Help Desk queue to meet service standards for responsiveness, accuracy, and quality.
- Identify, diagnose, categorize, and document requests/incidents; resolve known issues using SOPs and knowledge articles.
- Execute routine transactions reliably (e.g., data updates, verifications, information requests) with strong data integrity and confidentiality.
- Maintain and improve team knowledge base content to drive self-service and first-reply resolution.
- Spot patterns and trends in tickets; partner with subject matter experts to recommend process, policy, or tooling improvements.
- Communicate with empathy and professionalism, ensuring a positive employee experience in every interaction.
What You’ll Need to Succeed
- Employee experience mindset: service-oriented, empathetic, and consistent in balancing speed, accuracy, and integrity.
- Ownership and initiative: self-starter who follows through, closes loops, and raises improvement ideas with evidence.
- Communication: clear, concise English (written and verbal); explains policies in a friendly, practical way.
- Quality and detail: high accuracy in data entry, categorization, case notes, and knowledge updates.
- Collaboration: team-first approach; keeps stakeholders informed and shares learnings.
- Problem solving and analysis:
- Pattern recognition: connect recurring themes across tickets, data, and workflows.
- Perceptive judgment: ask clarifying questions, identify root causes, and distinguish policy, process, and system issues.
- Structured thinking: break problems into steps, apply SOPs, and document outcomes for reuse.
It’s Great If You Have
- Minimum of 1 year experience handling inquiries or requests in a fast-paced environment; familiarity with SOPs
- Bachelor's degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related field.
- Fluency in English, and Thai
- Experience in a similar position is an advantage.
- Any experience / comfortable using HRIS/ticketing tools.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer, Back End (Bangkok based, Relocation provided)
jobs.description:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get to Know our Team
In Agoda’s Back End Engineering department, we build the scalable, fault-tolerant systems and APIs that host our core business logic. Our systems cover all major areas of our business: inventory and pricing, product information, customer data, communications, partner data, booking systems, payments, and more. These mission-critical systems change frequently with dozens of releases per day, so we must employ state-of-the-art CI/CD and testing techniques in order to make sure everything works without any downtime. We also ensure that our systems are self-healing, responding gracefully to extreme loads or unexpected input. In order to accomplish this, we use state-of-the-art languages like Scala and Go, data technologies like Kafka and Aerospike, and agile development practices. Most importantly though, we hire great people from all around the world and empower them to be successful. Whether it’s building new projects like Flights and Packages or reimagining our existing business, you’ll make a big impact as part of the Back End Engineering team.
The Opportunity
Agoda Platform team is looking for developers to work on mission-critical systems that serve millions of users daily. You will have the chance to work on innovative projects, using cutting-edge technologies, and make a significant impact on our business and the travel industry.​
In this Role, you'll get to:
- Architecting and developing highly scalable, mission critical back end systems
- Owning a big chunk of Agoda’s system all the way from the north-star & vision down to the bytecode level
- Enabling impactful collaboration and cross-team projects on big projects, making a dent in the quality of our services, code & architecture
- Providing thoughtful feedback, nurture an inclusive engineering environment, and champion engineering fundamentals. Bring out the best from your fellow engineers.
- Identifying and implementing opportunities for optimization across the technology stack, focusing on cost, efficiency, velocity & dev happiness
- Exhibiting technical leadership throughout the broader organization, conveying complex technical trade-offs to non-techies such as business owners & C-suite executives.
What you'll Need to Succeed:
- Overall experience of 10+ years in software engineering roles
- Proven hands-on experience, Experience with owning production services with significant impact on design, development, deployment, monitoring & evolution
- Curiosity, staying a-breast on technological improvements and open source advancement.
- Strong programming skills in languages such as Kotlin, Scala, Java, C#.
- Can perform deep research & take decisions on complex projects. Can easily toggle between running as a lone wolf and also works great as part of a pack
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical details to stakeholders at all levels.
- On top of being an expert in Back End, has understanding of challenges and trade-offs in the entire engineering universe, from Front End/ Mobile to Data 7 analytics
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
It's Great if you have:
- Master's or Ph.D. in a technical field
- Experience with Kubernetes for effective container orchestration and scaling
- Deep understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automation tools, and practices relevant to machine learning.
- Experience in programming with Rust, C or other low level language
This position is based in Bangkok, Thailand. (Relocation support is provided)

We are seeking a Principal Engineer to drive innovation across our AI-powered data experience and platform infrastructure.
This role combines leading the development of AI-powered data querying — enabling users to ask business questions in natural language and receive actionable insights — while shaping the evolution of our data quality tools, and analytical engines such as StarRocks.

- Strong hands-on experience with:
- SQL and large-scale data systems
- Modern analytical databases / data warehouses (e.g., StarRocks, Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse)
- Backend development (e.g., Python, Java, Scala or similar)
- Experience building or working with:
- AI/LLM-based applications (e.g., text-to-SQL, conversational interfaces, cursor, copilots)
- Data platforms or analytical infrastructure at scale
- Strong understanding of data modeling, query execution, and performance optimization
- Proven ability to lead cross-team, high-impact technical initiatives
- Ability to navigate between deep hands-on work and strategic technical leadership
- Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
It's Great if you have:
- Experience with text-to-SQL systems or AI-driven data interfaces
- Experience implementing or scaling analytical engines such as StarRocks
- Background in data observability, quality, or governance frameworks
- Experience with tools like dbt, Airflow, Spark, or similar

jobs.title: Staff AI Security Analyst
jobs.description:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Get to Know Our Team
The Security Department oversees security, compliance, GRC, and security operations for all Agoda. We are vigilant in ensuring there is no breach or vulnerability threatening our company or endangering our employees in order to keep Agoda safe and protected. This would be a great challenge for those who want to work with the best technology in a dynamic and advanced environment.
The Opportunity
You will be joining Agoda's AppSec Analyst team at a pivotal moment: AI is changing both how we defend Agoda and what we need to defend. As Staff AI Security Analyst, your primary focus will be augmenting day-to-day application security work with AI, including vulnerability management and triage, zero-day response, and penetration testing of our applications, AI agents, and AI integrations.
This is a builder's role. You will ship and own production-grade AI tooling and automation, not one-off scripts, so a lean team can keep pace with a fast-moving DevSecOps environment where code ships continuously. You will bring a proactive, automation-first mindset, and as a senior member of the team, you will mentor others and raise the team's AI fluency.
What You Will Do
- Vulnerability management: Own daily triage of scanner, bug bounty, and pentest findings, using AI to cut duplicates and false positives. Prioritize based on exploitability and business impact, and drive fixes to verified closure within SLA.
- Zero-day response: Assess exposure to zero-day and newly disclosed vulnerabilities within hours, using AI, dependency inventories, and code search. Coordinate urgent patching or mitigation with engineering teams and track every affected service to closure.
- Penetration testing: Lead manual and AI-assisted pentests of web, API, and mobile apps, verifying every AI finding by hand. Test AI agents and integrations for prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool abuse, and data leakage, and review third-party AI components and MCP servers.
- Automated security testing: Design and suggest adversarial and automated security checks into CI/CD. Track how attackers use AI, such as automated exploit generation and faster vulnerability discovery, and adjust testing priorities to match.
- AI tooling for AppSec: Build and own production AI agents that automate AppSec work, grounded in internal standards and past findings. Red-team them against prompt injection, and measure triage accuracy, time saved, and false-finding rates.
- Leadership and mentorship: Contribute towards the AI AppSec roadmap and define what AI may do on its own, what needs human approval, and what data it can access. Track how attackers use AI, and mentor junior analysts to raise the team's AI fluency.
What You Will Bring
- Application and offensive security: 6 to 10 years of experience in application security, product security, or offensive security, with strong web and API penetration testing skills and hands on vulnerability management at scale.
- Vulnerability triage and prioritization: Proven ability to validate and reproduce bug bounty and external researcher reports, recommend appropriate rewards, and prioritize remediation using CVSS, EPSS, KEV, and business context.
- Supply chain and incident response: Deep understanding of dependency and software supply chain risks, including SCA and SBOM practices, with experience responding to zero day and high-profile vulnerabilities across large engineering organizations.
- AI security and technical leadership: Hands on experience building LLM tools or agents using Python, LLM APIs, RAG, or evaluation methods, and testing AI applications and agents. Demonstrated ability to mentor others and lead technical work across teams.
It is Great if You Have
- Experience running or managing a bug bounty program on platforms such as HackerOne.
- Experience fine-tuning or adapting models for security tasks.
- Experience with MCP servers, agent frameworks, and AI red-teaming tools.
- Experience building security automation into CI/CD and developer workflows.
- Background in software development and cloud-native application security.
- Relevant certifications (e.g., OSCP, OSWE, GWAPT), published CVEs or research, or conference talks.
Salary and Location
This role is based in Singapore.
Monthly base salary: SGD 10,900-16,300

The Security Department oversees application security, compliance, GRC, and security operations for all Agoda. We are vigilant in ensuring there is no breach or vulnerability threatening our company or endangering our employees in order to keep Agoda safe and protected. This would be a great challenge for those who want to work with the best technology in a dynamic and advanced environment.
The Opportunity
You will be joining the AppSec Engineering team at a pivotal moment: AI is changing both how we defend Agoda and what we need to defend. As an AI Security Engineer, you will build AI-powered security engineering capabilities that let a lean team secure a fast paced DevSecOps environment where code ships continuously, and you will make sure the AI systems and agents Agoda builds are secure by design. This is a builder's role with a primary focus on security engineering and threat modeling: you will ship and own production systems, not just own one-off scripts.
What You Will Do
- Design, build, and operate AI-powered security engineering systems, such as LLM-driven secure code review, finding triage and de-duplication, and automated fix suggestions, and own them end-to-end in production.
- Build AI-assisted threat modeling that scales our design reviews: drafting threat models from design docs and architecture, flagging high-risk changes, and routing the reviews that need a human in the room.
- Harden the AI developer platforms our engineers use every day, such as Cursor, Codex and Claude, always-on agent platforms including MCP/plugin governance and policy controls.
- Lead security design reviews and threat modeling for the AI systems and agents built at Agoda, including LLM-integrated products, RAG pipelines, MCP/tool integrations, and internal agentic platforms.
- Define and implement security controls and guardrails for AI agents: agent identity and delegated credentials, least-privilege tool access, sandboxing, human-in-the-loop approval for risky actions, and audit logging.
- Develop defenses against AI-specific threats such as prompt injection, data exfiltration through tools, insecure output handling, and model and supply chain risks, and turn them into secure-by-default patterns and standards for engineering teams.
- Build agentic security tooling that automates AppSec workflows end-to-end, from intake and risk scoring to ticketing and remediation tracking, keeping outcomes measurable, auditable, and safe.
- Measure and continuously improve the quality of our AI security tooling (precision, coverage, false-positive rate) by tuning models, prompts, and pipelines.
- Partner with product, platform, data, and AI engineering teams as an embedded security owner, and work closely with AppSec analysts to turn their findings into scalable, automated fixes.
- Stay ahead of AI security research and industry frameworks, and share what you learn across Agoda's engineering community.
What You Will Bring
- Software engineering and production systems: Strong software engineering foundations, with at least 3 years of SDLC experience in Python, Go, TypeScript/Node.js, Kotlin, or similar, and a track record of building and operating production quality systems.
- Security expertise: At least 6 years of relevant experience across security engineering, application security, threat modeling, secure coding, identity and access management, software development, or cloud security. Strong knowledge of secure design for distributed systems and microservices, OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and code level remediation, OAuth 2.0/OIDC, service to service authentication, and least privilege.
- Cloud and AI security: At least 2 years of experience with public or private cloud environments, and 1 year of hands on experience building LLM enabled applications, agents, tool calling/MCP, RAG, or evaluation pipelines. Understand key AI and LLM risks, including prompt injection, excessive agency, sensitive data leakage, and insecure output handling, with familiarity with OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications or MITRE ATLAS.
- Security mindset: Applies an analytical, offensive security mindset to identify and understand how vulnerabilities are discovered and exploited. Uses AI thoughtfully as part of their work, exercises autonomy in ambiguous problem spaces, and communicates technical and nontechnical concepts effectively to diverse audiences.
It is Great if You Have
- Experience securing agentic, code-execution, or LLM-integrated systems in production (sandboxing, isolation, guardrails).
- Experience building developer-facing security tooling or security automation integrated into CI/CD.
- Experience with LLM evaluation or red-teaming of AI systems, or contributions to AI security research, open-source tools, or community frameworks.
- Familiarity with AI governance and risk frameworks such as NIST AI RMF or ISO/IEC 42001.
Salary and Location
This role is based in Singapore.
Monthly base salary: SGD 10,900-16,300

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds high-scale, fault-tolerant distributed systems that power a global travel platform serving millions of users daily. We own mission-critical domains across inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms. Our systems run with high availability, low latency, and zero-downtime expectations, powered by modern technologies such as Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike, along with strong foundations in CI/CD, automation, and observability. We ship fast—often dozens of releases a day—and design systems that are resilient, self-healing, and built to scale globally.
The Opportunity
As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end-to-end — from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.
What You will Do
- Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
- Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end-to-end, within your service or team
- Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
- Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
- Optimize high-throughput, low-latency systems
- Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
- Make independent architectural and technical trade-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
- Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team

- Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
- Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow-through improvements

Technical
- 8–12 years of backend engineering experience
- Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
- Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
- Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs & system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
- Strong coding and problem-solving ability
Beyond the technical bar:
- A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks — initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
- Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
- Experience communicating trade-offs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
- Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

- Experience building large-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
- Exposure to event-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
- Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)

- Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

Get to Know our Team:
The Full Stack Engineering Department builds the Agoda web and app products. We have several teams in front-end focusing on different aspects of our products including accommodations, flights, payments, marketing, post-booking services, and more. Agoda’s marketplace is the world. We build localized and optimized user experiences at scale on every major internet platform. These include our mobile websites, native apps, and desktop sites. We hire people from around the world who have a passion for using technology to create and implement the best user experiences. Our teams work on the full stack and build end-to-end systems including user interfaces, APIs, backend systems, and database systems. Our products are always evolving and under experimentation. We accomplish this by having an amazing degree of automation, CI/CD systems, and use a modularized approach. As we are data driven and measure our results, we continually innovate and improve our work. We are looking for the next great talent who strives to learn and grow and has a standard of excellence, strong sense of ownership, and great technical skills.
The Opportunity:
Staff Engineer is the key role in our technology organization working together with individual contributors and senior leadership. Our Lead engineers are heavily involved in the hiring and mentoring process and are the go-to people who design and implement new systems and components. We are looking for people who are passionate to take on more responsibility and driving major architectural changes in Agoda. It's expected from you in this role as Staff engineer to push Agoda forward technically by adopting new technologies and setting higher standards.
The Impact You’ll Make
- Lead full-stack architecture and system design for features used by millions of customers across web and cross-platform environments.
- Own complex end-to-end systems: Take responsibility for building, integrating, and maintaining both frontend and backend components, including the critical Backend for Frontend (BFF) layer.
- Mentor and guide high-performing teams: Provide technical leadership, drive engineering excellence, and support the growth of your peers.
- Drive technical decisions: Influence architecture and best practices across multiple squads, ensuring scalable, reliable, and high-quality solutions.
- Collaborate with Product and Design: Work closely with cross-functional partners to deliver cohesive, user-centered features and experiments that directly impact business outcomes.
What We’re Looking For
- 8+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong record of technical leadership and end-to-end ownership.
- Expertise in Scala, Kotlin, Python, and JavaScript/TypeScript, plus hands-on experience with frameworks such as Node.js and React (or similar TypeScript frameworks).
- Proven experience leading end-to-end architecture on high-traffic, high-availability platforms, ideally with exposure to cross-platform or migration projects (e.g., native to WebView).
- BFF (Backend for Frontend) experience is a must: You have designed, built, or maintained BFF layers (language flexible—C#, Kotlin, Java, etc.) that bridge frontend and backend systems.
- Track record of technical mentorship, cross-team collaboration, and solving ambiguous, complex problems in fast-paced environments.
- Strong API and middleware skills: Ability to design and implement APIs and backend services tailored for frontend needs.
Nice to Have
- Experience with Java or other JVM languages.
- Exposure to cloud platforms, microservices, and modern DevOps practices.
- Prior work on large-scale migration or cross-platform initiatives.

Our Opportunity
As our Staff Full Stack Engineer, you will design and build AI-driven chat experiences that power Agoda’s AI Assistant, trip planning and discovery, customer support flows, and proactive recommendations. You’ll work closely with engineers, data scientists, and product managers to define, build, and scale the next generation of AI solutions that make travel planning more intuitive, personalized, and effortless for millions of customers worldwide.
We’re looking for a visionary Full Stack architect with a strong hands-on mentality — integrating innovative AI capabilities and rapidly validating ideas through experimentation. You will create measurable impact on traveler experience and business outcomes, while upholding Agoda’s standards for privacy, reliability, and the responsible use of AI.
Why Agoda & Why Bangkok?
- Global Engineering, Global Impact: Join a high-energy, multilingual and multicultural engineering team in Bangkok driving innovation across regions.
- Vibrant Bangkok HQ: Work in a tech-centric city with a thriving expat community, beautiful culture, and world-famous cuisine.
- English-First: Work and collaborate in English—no Thai required!
- World-class relocation and family support are offered.
The Impact You’ll Make
- Lead full-stack architecture and system design for features used by millions of customers
- Own complex end-to-end systems — from React-based frontend to backend microservices — and mentor high-performing teams
- Design and evolve Backend-for-Frontend (BFF) layers that aggregate downstream services into optimized, UI-friendly contracts
- Guide technical decisions across several squads, driving engineering excellence
- Collaborate with Product and Design to deliver cohesive, user-centered solutions at scale
What We’re Looking For
- 8+ years of experience in software engineering (web, backend, or full stack)
- Frontend: Hands-on proficiency with React and its ecosystem — Next.js (SSR/SSG), TypeScript, state management (Redux, Zustand, or similar), component libraries, and build tooling (Webpack/Vite)
- Backend: Expertise in Java, Kotlin, or .NET; comfort designing microservices and REST/gRPC APIs
- BFF / middleware: Experience building and owning Node.js/TypeScript BFF layers that sit between frontend and core services, including API aggregation, response shaping, and auth handling
- Solid understanding of frontend performance fundamentals: Core Web Vitals, code splitting, lazy loading, and rendering strategies (CSR vs SSR vs ISR)
- Familiarity with testing approaches across the stack — unit, integration, and E2E (Jest, Cypress, or Playwright)
- Proven experience leading end-to-end architecture on high-traffic platforms
- Track record of technical mentorship, cross-team collaboration, and solving ambiguous problems
What We Offer
Full Relocation and Onboarding Support:
- Visa sponsorship for you and your family
- Flights, settling-in allowance, and temporary housing
- Dedicated relocation and settling-in advisors
- Relocation buddy program and community events
Family & Expat Benefits:
- Partner & children support (school search, legal, etc.)
- International health insurance
- Flexible home visit support
Agoda Perks:
- Hybrid working (Bangkok HQ)
- Professional growth and learning budget
- Employee resource groups for every culture and background

The Full Stack Engineering Department builds the Agoda web and app products. We have several teams in front-end focusing on different aspects of our products including accommodations, flights, payments, marketing, post-booking services, and more. Agoda’s marketplace is the world. We build localized and optimized user experiences at scale on every major internet platform. These include our mobile websites, native apps, and desktop sites. We hire people from around the world who have a passion for using technology to create and implement the best user experiences. Our teams work on the full stack and build end-to-end systems including user interfaces, APIs, backend systems, and database systems. Our products are always evolving and under experimentation. We accomplish this by having an amazing degree of automation, CI/CD systems, and use a modularized approach. As we are data driven and measure our results, we continually innovate and improve our work. We are looking for the next great talent who strives to learn and grow and has a standard of excellence, strong sense of ownership, and great technical skills.
The Opportunity:
Staff Engineer is the key role in our technology organization working together with individual contributors and senior leadership. Our Lead engineers are heavily involved in the hiring and mentoring process and are the go-to people who design and implement new systems and components. We are looking for people who are passionate to take on more responsibility and driving major architectural changes in Agoda. It's expected from you in this role as Staff engineer to push Agoda forward technically by adopting new technologies and setting higher standards.
The Impact You’ll Make
- Lead full-stack architecture and system design for features used by millions of customers across web and cross-platform environments.
- Own complex end-to-end systems: Take responsibility for building, integrating, and maintaining both frontend and backend components, including the critical Backend for Frontend (BFF) layer.
- Mentor and guide high-performing teams: Provide technical leadership, drive engineering excellence, and support the growth of your peers.
- Drive technical decisions: Influence architecture and best practices across multiple squads, ensuring scalable, reliable, and high-quality solutions.
- Collaborate with Product and Design: Work closely with cross-functional partners to deliver cohesive, user-centered features and experiments that directly impact business outcomes.
What We’re Looking For
- 8+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong record of technical leadership and end-to-end ownership.
- Expertise in Java, Kotlin, .NET, and JavaScript/TypeScript, plus hands-on experience with frameworks such as Node.js and React (or similar TypeScript frameworks).
- Proven experience leading end-to-end architecture on high-traffic, high-availability platforms, ideally with exposure to cross-platform or migration projects (e.g., native to WebView).
- BFF (Backend for Frontend) experience is a must: You have designed, built, or maintained BFF layers (language flexible—C#, Kotlin, Java, etc.) that bridge frontend and backend systems.
- Track record of technical mentorship, cross-team collaboration, and solving ambiguous, complex problems in fast-paced environments.
- Strong API and middleware skills: Ability to design and implement APIs and backend services tailored for frontend needs.
Nice to Have
- Experience with Scala or other JVM languages.
- Exposure to cloud platforms, microservices, and modern DevOps practices.
- Prior work on large-scale migration or cross-platform initiatives.
- Android and/or iOS native development experience

jobs.description:
About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Summer internship period: 24th May - 30th July 2027
Get to Know our Team:
In Agoda’s Back End Engineering department, we build the scalable, fault-tolerant systems and APIs that host our core business logic. Our systems cover all major areas of our business: inventory and pricing, product information, customer data, communications, partner data, booking systems, payments, and more. These mission-critical systems change frequently with dozens of releases per day, so we must employ state-of-the-art CI/CD and testing techniques in order to make sure everything works without any downtime. We also ensure that our systems are self-healing, responding gracefully to extreme loads or unexpected input. In order to accomplish this, we use state-of-the-art languages like Scala and C#, data technologies like Kafka and Spark, and agile development practices. Most importantly though, we hire great people from all around the world and empower them to be successful. Whether it’s building new projects like Flights and Packages or reimagining our existing business, you’ll make a big impact as part of the Back End Engineering team.
The Opportunity:
You might call yourself “full stack” or "back end" or you might consider yourself an authority in a certain field, but you will have a keen interest in how the different systems work together.
We'd love to hear from you if you are experienced in any of the technologies we work with (note - we are not looking for you to have them all). We are interested in speaking to persons of any level from individuals just starting their IT careers to experts in their field.
In this Role, you'll get to:
- A chance to contribute to a top-notch codebase and work on scalable, fault-tolerant systems and APIs that serve millions of requests
- You will use state-of-the-art languages like Scala and C#, data technologies like Kafka and Spark, and agile development practices
- You must employ state-of-the-art CI/CD and testing techniques in order to make sure everything works without any downtime
- Think about the full life cycle of our products, and not just about a single piece of code - from product requirements, technology selection to coding standards, agile development, testing, deployment and monitoring
What you'll Need to Succeed:
- Studying for a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science or any related fields
- Familiar with basics of Object-oriented and/or Functional programming
- Familiar with relational and/or non-relational databases
- Good English communication skill
- Ready to learn fast
It's Great if you have:
- Practical knowledge with Scala, C# or Java
- You have built some back-end applications and services. You understand the basics of system scaling
- Familiar with data platforms like MS SQL, Cassandra or Hadoop. You understand that different applications have different data requirements
- Core engineering infrastructure tools like Git for source control, TeamCity for Continuous Integration and Puppet for deployment

About Agoda
At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.
Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.
No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.
Summer internship period: 24th may - 30th July 2027
The Opportunity:
Join us as an Intern in one of the Data Platform Teams which together manage the data infrastructure serving as the core backbone for all Agoda’s Data needs. The Data Platform spans four teams:
- Data Pipeline: Maintaining large scale Data Pipelines spanning trillions of events a day across multiple Data Centers
- Data Lake Operations: Administering our massive Hadoop Data Lakes at ~30+ PB scale for our data storage and computational needs
- Data Applications: Creating self-service data tools/apps (e.g. ETL, Synchronization Tools, Discoverability Tools, Data Quality Tools etc.) for use by anyone in Agoda
- Data Experience: Promoting Data Democratization and Usage through intuitive Web UIs that make it easy for any Agoda employee to interact with data
If you are interested in Data Engineering and Big Data, then this is the right internship program for you. You’ll have opportunity to work with large distributed system such as Apache Kafka, Elasticsearch, Hadoop, Object Storage, Spark, Docker, Kubernetes etc.
In this Role, you'll get to: 
- Start off by learning about our Systems, going through the onboarding courses (based off one of the 4 teams that you’ll join)
- Based on your interests, you’ll have an opportunity to choose which components you would like to work on.
- At which point, you’ll be assigned a mentor. Together, you’ll then decide on an internship project and go through the full development cycle within the course of your internship.
- You will take a project from ideation all the way to production. You would come up with an idea, develop a proof of concept, write tests, build dashboards, make your code production ready, deploy to production, debug issues, and learn how to automate everything.
- Come out at the end of the Internship shipping real code, understanding what it takes to deal with TB to PB worth of data, how to design good and scalable software, learning more about large distributed systems, and seeing your code run in Production
What you'll Need to Succeed:
- Be an Undergraduate / Graduate in an IT related / Computer Science or equivalent degree
- Proficient in at least one of these languages: Go, Python
- Good communication skills, Fast learner, Positive and Open Attitude
- Ability to work independently and as a team player
- Strong English speaking and writing skills
It's Great if you have:
- Knowledge and experiences in Kubernetes, Apache Hive, Apache Iceberg
