About the team
Metronome, now part of Stripe, is the leading usage-based billing platform built for modern software companies. With Metronome, companies can launch products faster, offer any pricing model, and streamline finance workflows without writing code.
Our platform computes millions of invoices per billing period and is scaling rapidly to accommodate new customers, saving them hours of development time and manual invoicing and enabling them to use consumption data to better serve their customers. Our customers love our product and approach, and we’re humbled to work with amazing companies like OpenAI, NVIDIA, Confluent, and Anthropic.
What you’ll do
As a member of our technical support engineering team, you will be on the front lines providing world-class customer service. As part of our engineering organization, you will become an expert on our product and partner closely with Metronome's engineers, customer success, solutions architecture, and growth teams, as well as our customers' developers.
Your primary responsibilities will include handling customer escalations through our ticketing system, using internal observability tools to diagnose and scope customer-facing issues, collaborating directly with customers via Slack and other channels, and developing internal tools and documentation to improve the support experience. Since we view every support escalation as an opportunity to learn, both as individuals and as a company, you will play a critical role in providing feedback to our product team on common challenges and influencing our product roadmap.
Through your interactions with individual customers, you will help improve our product for everyone. Your work will play a crucial role in ensuring our customers' success and the continued effectiveness of their integration with Metronome.
Responsibilities
- Provide technical guidance to customers’ developers on best practices for integrating with our APIs and utilizing our functionality.
- Troubleshoot any issues that arise from customers and diagnose any blockers. Escalate issues with customer context to the engineering team.
- Develop internal tools to automate customer workflows that are currently unavailable in our product. Provide feedback on recurring patterns and advocate for addressing feature gaps in the product.
- Design and assist in implementing a comprehensive knowledge base to assist customers with using our product.
Who you are
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
Minimum requirements
- 2+ years of work experience in a B2B customer-facing technical support organization or in engineering
- Experience working closely with engineering teams and providing technical feedback on customer issues
- Ability to debug and triage bugs and escalations from customers
- Can communicate technical capabilities of the product to customers
- Experience writing scripts or internal tools using APIs, and functional knowledge of SQL
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to break down complex technical concepts clearly
- A mindset of customer empathy and ability to solve challenging problems
Preferred qualifications
- Experience as an early or founding member of a support team, including building processes from scratch
- Startup experience and familiarity with scaling a support team
- Programming experience in one or more of Typescript, Python, or Ruby
- You have worked on modern enterprise software which is business critical
- Experience creating knowledge base articles and internal documentation
- Familiarity with at least one ticketing system, such as Pylon, Zendesk, Front, or similar

jobs.description:
Who we are

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
Research at Stripe
Stripe’s mission is to increase the GDP of the internet and expand economic access globally. We design tools and infrastructure to help our users start, run, and scale an online business from anywhere in the world. We believe there are too many barriers to doing business on the internet and that opportunities are not equally distributed around the world. We also believe that building and growing a business online is a problem rooted in code, language, and design, not finance.
That’s where you come in. We’re looking for an experienced UX Research Manager to join our growing UX Research team and help build, coach, and mentor a growing and highly skilled group of researchers.
About UX research and the role
The UX Research team is part of Stripe’s Design team. It works across brand and product initiatives to deliver products and experiences that meet user needs. Since Stripe’s main audience is people who build products, we take pride in creating user-friendly, user-focused experiences.
In addition to conducting primary research, we enable other Stripes, including engineers, product managers, designers, and operations teams, to learn and apply research skills to global problems. You will help shape research as a core competency across Stripe and define how we put users first in our research.
What you’ll do
As a UX Research Manager, you will use your people-management and research expertise to lead a team of researchers that collaborates with product teams on core Payments and Risk products to build insight-driven product experiences. Core Payments includes Stripe’s in-person and online payment capabilities, checkout suite, Radar, and smart solutions that help businesses achieve optimal payment performance while balancing regulatory requirements, conversion, costs, and fraud considerations.
You will report to the Head of Research.
Responsibilities
- Lead, manage, coach, and mentor a team of researchers conducting mixed-methods research throughout the product-development process for Stripe’s Payments and Risk product pillar.
- Lead initiatives and guide the research team through artificial intelligence (AI) transformation in its internal processes, how it conducts research for Stripe users, and how it supports the changing needs of product partners.
- Share research insights that deepen Stripe’s understanding of user needs and identify opportunities to meet those needs.
- Grow the team to meet Stripe’s needs while developing individual contributors to deliver impactful, actionable research studies.
- Partner with Design and Stripe leadership to determine how to best use user research at Stripe and deepen our understanding of users.
- Work as a strategic partner to business leads, product managers, design leaders, and Stripe leadership. Define long-term strategy and short-term tactics for products by grounding decisions in user needs and insights.
- Prioritize research needs and approaches across multiple workstreams. Select the right project, scale, and scope at the right time, and deliver actionable insights.
- Enable other Stripes to learn and apply research skills by building research programs, platforms, and toolkits that support tactical research.
- Partner closely with other researchers to build Stripe’s research practice and infrastructure, including sourcing research vendors to support your team’s work.
Who you are

Minimum requirements
- 7+ years of relevant user research experience working on digital experiences and generating actionable insights that drive impact.
- 3+ years of people-management and leadership experience.
- Experience directly managing, coaching, and developing a team of user researchers, as well as recruiting and building research teams.
- Ability to set and achieve priorities that balance the needs of users, projects, the Research team, and Stripe.
- Experience conducting project work while mentoring and supporting a team of user researchers as they develop their craft and conduct research.
Preferred qualifications
- Relevant experience in financial technology, particularly payment processing.
- Ability to motivate and inspire people to do their best work.
- Experience conducting complex research at scale using a range of methods, including qualitative interviews, surveys, ideation sessions, ethnographic field research, usability evaluations, and diary studies.

- Understanding of the balance between speed and rigor, and how research translates into design, product, and business decisions. Ability to work with urgency and focus while adapting methodological rigor to the situation.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About Us
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: London
About the Team
The Cloudflare Data Intelligence & Analytics (DIA) team has built a unified data & ML platform to provide our internal Business Partners with actionable analytics, insights, and recommendations.
Our goals are to:
- Democratize data & intelligence for humans and agents
- Build a context layer and an AI systems layer upon our unified data & content platform
- Support Cloudflare’s critical business needs
DIA is a ~ 75-member strong geographically distributed but organizationally centralized team. This role is within the growth & adoption analytics pod based in London that works across several business functions, offering broad exposure to Cloudflare's entire business.
Role Summary
We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst in London to scale our growth & adoption analytics initiatives. You will be a trusted data advisor to our business partners, a technical coach to your peers, and the lead in terms of shaping AI-first data models, workflows, and agent-ready-datasets.
Success in this role will rely on marrying a strong analytics background with product and business acumen to deliver highly strategic and compelling insights that accelerate growth and influence adoption. This role also requires a deep understanding of data infrastructure, job orchestration, and lineage, all with the use of AI-tooling as default.
Role Responsibilities
- Own the development and maintenance of agent-ready curated datasets end-to-end
- Provide analytics support and a strategic perspective to our business partners
- Partner with data engineers, product managers, and stakeholders to enable data-driven answers to key business problems
- Review Merge Requests created by your team of humans and agents
- Take initiative to gather requirements, define, build, and maintain pipelines and metrics
- Tell easily digestible and highly actionable stories with data to help stakeholders understand analytical insights
Role Requirements
- B.S. or M.S in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or other quantitative fields
- Demonstrable proficiency with analytics-relevant AI-tooling
- 4+ years experience in a centralized data analytics teams in close partnership with business stakeholders
- Expert-level proficiency in writing and optimizing complex SQL queries is mandatory, with a proven ability to performance-tune complex queries and manage analysis workflows against large, petabyte-scale datasets (Candidates will be assessed on advanced SQL skills including window functions and common table expressions (CTEs))
- 3+ years experience working in version control environments using platforms such as Gitlab or Github
- 2+ years experience working with job orchestration tools like Apache Airflow, both as a pipeline developer and reviewer
- 2+ years experience with data ingestion and transformation frameworks (e.g., dbt, Fivetran, or custom/in-house developed platforms)
- Initiative, curiosity, strong stakeholder engagement, and empathy
- Experience translating business questions into analysis frameworks, converting results into business recommendations, and presenting those to stakeholders
Nice-to-Have Experience
- Experience and/or a keen interest in internet security, protocols, and edge-development
- Analytics experience in a fast-growing technology, SaaS, or subscription-based business
- Experience with statistical analysis programming languages (Python, R etc.)
What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!
Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs. More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.
This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.
Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.
Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment. If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

Our products address a broad and evolving range of traffic integrity challenges. Examples include managing unwanted scraping, controlling access for bots and AI agents, and identifying fraud and abuse while minimizing friction for legitimate users. Our products make probabilistic decisions in an adversarial environment, using Cloudflare's global network signals, threat intelligence, and machine learning. We turn those signals into analytics and controls that customers can understand, trust, and act on. These are challenging engineering problems at the intersection of distributed systems, data, security, and customer experience.

We're looking for an experienced Data Center Operations manager to build and run the team that brings these new sites online and keeps them running around the clock.
You will build a distributed team of Data Center Engineers from the ground up. You'll be accountable for production hardware availability, 24x7 on-site response, and the operating model that lets this footprint scale.
The role means balancing competing demands every day: build deadlines against build quality, dependence on partners against high standards, and fast incident response against careful compliance. You need to keep both sides of each in view.
This role covers the physical layer: hardware, cabling, and Layer 1/Layer 2 connectivity. It works closely with network engineering and server provisioning teams but does not own them.
What You'll Do
Team Leadership
-
Hire, develop and manage Data Center Engineers based on-site at data centers across the US. Set clear expectations, career paths and a culture of ownership across a team spread over many sites.
-
Build and take part in a 24x7 on-call rotation with your team. Define coverage models, handover protocols and incident SLAs that hold up as the footprint grows.
-
Serve as the escalation point for on-site incidents. Coordinate engineers, colocation providers and vendors to restore service quickly, and lead root-cause analysis after major incidents so the same problem doesn't happen again.
Site Delivery
-
Own build timelines from site readiness through hardware delivery, rack-and-stack, cabling, validation and handoff to production.
-
Run greenfield builds as multi-workstream programs. Coordinate third-party integrators, contractors and colocation providers to hit dates without cutting corners.
-
Be on-site during key build phases to oversee vendor work, verify quality and make sure sites are production-ready.
Production Operations
-
Be accountable for availability targets for production hardware at your sites. Run break/fix, repairs, RMAs and spares strategy so that availability is measured, reported and improving.
-
Manage colocation providers and vendors day to day: escalations, remote-hands quality, power and cooling issues, and performance against contractual commitments.
Documentation and DCIM
-
Make sure every site is fully documented in DCIM from day one. That covers rack elevations, power and cabling, asset location, and lifecycle status, all recorded as hardware arrives rather than filled in later.
-
Treat infrastructure records as a source of truth that both operations and dependent teams rely on, giving them accurate, current visibility into where hardware is and what state it's in.
-
Partner with tooling teams to bring DCIM online at new sites, and define documentation standards that hold up as the footprint grows.
Decommissioning and Hardware Lifecycle
-
Own on-site decommissioning end to end: unracking, physical collections, serial number verification, chain of custody, and handoff for secure destruction.
-
Partner with vendor management on IT asset disposition (ITAD) vendors. Make sure destruction certificates and compliance evidence are filed and audit-ready.
Security and Compliance
-
Make sure your sites and team meet Cloudflare's physical security, access control, chain-of-custody and compliance obligations.
-
Follow established physical access procedures, and work with security and compliance teams to develop new ones where these sites need them.
-
Support audits with accurate, timely evidence. Treat audit readiness as a continuous standard, not something you prepare for once per audit cycle.
Automation and Operational Efficiency
-
Find manual, repetitive work in build, break/fix, decommissioning and evidence collection. Influence tooling and automation teams to remove it.
-
Evaluate and adopt AI-assisted workflows for incident triage, root-cause analysis, documentation and compliance evidence generation.
-
Scale the operation through tooling, not just headcount.
Business Reporting
-
Own weekly business reviews and monthly and quarterly reporting on availability, build progress, incidents and operational health to the Director and peer leaders.
-
Partner with network, systems, hardware, supply chain and infrastructure engineering teams to make sure physical operations support what runs on top of them.
Who You Are
A builder who stays to operate. You've stood up sites and teams, and you take ownership of what happens after go-live. Delivering a build is where your job starts. If it isn't documented, it isn't done.
A leader of distributed teams. You've hired and built trust with on-site engineers spread across many locations, most of whom you won't see day to day. You know how to create accountability, consistent standards and a shared culture across sites, both remotely and in person.
Firm with partners. You hold colocation providers and vendors to high standards without becoming adversarial. You know the contract, you track performance, and you escalate when it's warranted.
Compliance-minded without being a compliance specialist. You understand why access controls and decommissioning chain of custody are audit controls. You treat compliance as part of doing the work well, not as overhead.
Automation-first. When something hurts, your first instinct is to fix the process or the tooling, not add people. You can turn an operational pain point into requirements engineering teams can act on.
Required Experience
-
6+ years in data center operations, including 3+ years directly managing on-site technical teams. At least part of that time should be leading geographically distributed teams.
-
A track record of operating multi-site data center fleets at hyperscale or large-cloud scale.
-
Hands-on experience with IT hardware, including servers, network devices, optics and cabling, not only facilities infrastructure.
-
Enough hands-on depth to coach engineers on technical work and to judge the quality of vendor and contractor work.
-
Experience owning sites across the full lifecycle: delivering greenfield data center or cage builds through third-party vendors, running them in steady state, and decommissioning hardware.
-
Experience managing providers in Tier III+ colocation facilities and holding them accountable to commitments.
-
Experience managing 24x7 on-call operations and incident escalation.
-
Strong Layer 1 and Layer 2 fundamentals: structured cabling, fiber and optics, patching standards, switching basics, and troubleshooting physical connectivity for network and server hardware.
-
Solid knowledge of data center power and cooling, rack design, high-density deployments and hardware lifecycle management.
-
Strong understanding of DCIM and asset management systems. You should have a track record of keeping documentation accurate from day one, including rack, power, cabling and asset records maintained from hardware arrival through decommissioning.
-
Working knowledge of the security and compliance frameworks common in enterprise-grade data centers. You should understand them well enough to run operations under them; auditor-level expertise isn't required.
-
Strong program management skills across multiple vendors, sites and time-bound workstreams.
-
A track record of reducing toil through tooling or process redesign.
-
Excellent written and verbal communication, including regular business reviews and status, risk and availability reporting to leadership.
-
Ability to travel regularly to data center sites. Expect more frequent travel during site builds, shifting to periodic visits as sites reach steady state.
Preferred Qualifications
-
Experience standing up a new data center operations function or region from zero.

Background at a hyperscaler, cloud provider, major CDN or similarly fast-scaling infrastructure company.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Stablecoins
jobs.description:
About Us
At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: London or Austin or SF or NYC
About the Department
Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.
About the Team
We build the infrastructure that makes the web Payable, powering high-volume, low-value machine-to-machine transactions using blockchain technologies and decentralized protocols. Here at Cloudflare, stablecoin payments are a core initiative developing blockchain-based settlement systems, programmable agent wallets, and cryptographic primitives to make the web payable at machine scale. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We build tools that leverage Web3 wallets and decentralized rails to give domain owners and agents secure, scalable settlement options.
Building these capabilities requires solving problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols. We bridge mainstream commerce rails with decentralized smart contract environments, enabling micropayments at Internet scale to keep the web payable.
We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.
About the role
We are looking for an Engineering Manager to build and lead the engineering team across our stablecoin initiatives.
You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind products that power decentralized agent transactions, such as Cloudflare’s stablecoin wallets and emerging micropayment rails that make web resources payable. You will partner closely with Product Management, cryptography experts, and engineering teams across Cloudflare to deliver current priorities and shape future opportunities. This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible in distributed systems, smart contracts, and cryptographic protocols. You will not be expected to write most of the code, but you should be able to understand the systems your engineers operate, challenge architectural decisions around blockchains (including transactions, RPCs, and execution + consensus clients) and step in when necessary.
At the same time, we are looking for a manager, not a tech lead with direct reports. Your success will be measured by the quality and output of the team you build, the engineers you develop, and the systems and products they deliver.
This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.
What you'll do
- Manage, coach, and grow engineers working across blockchain architecture, stablecoin wallets, and cryptographic payment channels to ensure the web remains payable for autonomous agents.
- Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product.
- Lead the development of a high-throughput blockchain leveraging cryptocurrency protocols and standards to enable ultra-low-latency micropayments.
- Lead the engineering behind usage metering, pricing definition engines, outcome verification, and revenue attribution models tailored for agentic workflows.
- Build capabilities that give businesses granular visibility and control over their agent-generated revenue streams.
- Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes.
- Interface directly with blockchain, wallet, and cryptography teams while scaling decentralized transaction pipelines on Cloudflare Workers and Durable Objects.
- Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow.
- Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, cryptographic security, and long-term reliability.
- Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation.
Responsibilities
We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if:
- You have led and developed a high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.
- You are technically credible with experienced blockchain and systems engineers. You can review a design, understand the trade-offs in smart contract security or decentralized architecture, and evaluate cryptographic protocols.
- You are comfortable managing a team working across specialized crypto topics (like decentralized settlement, programmable wallets, and key management systems).
- You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system handles monetary transactions or machine authorization.
- You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement and what should not be built at all.
- You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.
- You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.
Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience
- Strong technical grounding in blockchain architecture, smart contract environments, and cryptographic key management. Past experience building L1 or L2 blockchains is a plus.
- Experience building or operating cryptocurrency infrastructure, digital wallet providers, or decentralized settlement protocols. Past experience working on consumer or enterprise cryptocurrency wallets is a plus.
- Experience operating systems where correctness, reliability, and security matter as much as feature delivery.
- A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.
- Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap.
- Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous opportunity to a clear customer outcome.
- Strong written and verbal communication.
Bonus Points
- Hands-on experience with decentralized payment protocols or blockchain frameworks (e.g., Bitcoin Lightning, Ethereum rollups).
- Experience building hybrid fiat/crypto payment infrastructure, such as onramp/offramp providers or apps where cryptocurrencies are invisible to users.
- Familiarity with Cloudflare’s developer platform (Workers, Durable Objects, KV) or edge computing architectures.
- Experience turning complex underlying systems into useful payment or commerce products for a broad audience.
- Experience with usage-based billing, metering engines, attribution systems, or complex commercial pricing models.
- Previous experience working in payments or on payments technology (fiat or crypto)
Compensation
Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.
- For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $200,000 - $288,000
- For NYC based hires: Estimated annual salary of $190,000 - $275,000

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

Application Administration & Environment Management
- Serve as the primary subject-matter expert and developer for Cloudflare’s O2C and R2R technology stack (NetSuite, Zuora RevPro, Oracle Fusion).

- Manage application environments (e.g., Production vs. Sandbox/Release Preview), ensuring alignment across all environments from both a data and release perspective to support safe testing of financial changes.
- Monitor ongoing application performance and reliability, managing incident workflows to ensure ticket SLAs for the Finance organization are consistently met, especially during critical month-end and quarter-end close periods.
- Provide Tier 3 support and end-user enablement, serving as the ultimate technical escalation point for financial system issues.
System Development, Integrations & AI Initiatives
- Act as the Subject-Matter Expert for integrations across the QTC, O2C, and R2R lifecycles. Ensure the seamless flow of data (e.g., syncing closed-won opportunities to NetSuite/Oracle, passing billing data to Zuora RevPro, and ensuring subledger transactions map flawlessly to the GL).
- Design, build, and deploy custom system enhancements, automated billing schedules, journal entry automations, revenue allocation scripts (e.g., SuiteScript), and API integrations between our platforms.
- Lead the evaluation, implementation, and governance of native AI features within the financial stack (e.g., AI-driven anomaly detection in journal entries and revenue schedules, automated cash application matching, or intelligent account reconciliations) to accelerate financial operations.
- Proactively monitor vendors' quarterly updates and product roadmaps. Lead impact assessments, manage versioning/upgrades, and educate Finance stakeholders on new functionality and AI opportunities.
Process Management & Workflow Design
- Partner directly with the Chief Accounting Officer's organization, Revenue Accounting, Corporate Accounting, and Billing teams to deeply understand their operational processes and translate business requirements into sophisticated system solutions.
- Own the design, configuration, and delivery of complex workflows (e.g., dynamic invoice routing, automated dunning processes, intercompany eliminations, and month-end close orchestrations) to eliminate manual bottlenecks.
- Build and maintain scalable system architectures that support complex, high-volume recurring billing, usage-based consumption models, and multi-entity global consolidations.

- Partner closely with Internal Audit, Risk, and Compliance teams to maintain robust IT General Controls (ITGC) and strict enterprise-wide data governance for financial and customer data.
- Spearhead and execute Quarterly Access Reviews (UAR) for all O2C and R2R applications, ensuring accurate access levels and enforcing strict Segregation of Duties (SoD) across billing, revenue, and general ledger operations.
- Ensure newly implemented AI features, custom scripts, and data-sharing protocols strictly adhere to SOX compliance, maintain data integrity, and ensure audit readiness for all financial records and ASC 606 reporting.
- Maintain comprehensive system architecture documentation, process maps, and business continuity/disaster recovery plans for critical financial systems.

- Audit & Compliance Acumen: Extensive experience working in a strict SOX-compliant public company environment. Highly comfortable managing quarterly access reviews, defining SoD for accounting operations, and defending system controls to audit teams.
- Process-Oriented: A deep understanding of core Order-to-Cash (O2C), Revenue Recognition (ASC 606), and Record-to-Report (R2R) business processes, including global consolidations and the month-end close cycle.
- Communication: Excellent communication skills, with a proven ability to partner effectively with Finance/Accounting leadership and bridge the gap between technical architecture and financial outcomes.

- Run hands-on qualification: benchmarking, stress testing, failure mode analysis, and vendor RCA — you close the loop yourself
- Assess and qualify ODM/OEM server platforms; engage directly with vendors and work through the full technical qualification cycle
- Translate AI product and workload requirements into precise infrastructure specifications
- Identify gaps in the existing infrastructure stack and drive solutions across hardware, firmware, software, and operations

- Build tooling and automation to support qualification workflows, performance analysis, and ongoing operational visibility

- Experience in AI infrastructure, systems engineering, or hardware platform engineering

- Hands-on experience qualifying AI server platforms — you've run NCCL tests, profiled collective operations, debugged NVLink errors, and chased down PCIe lane misconfigurations
- Understand rack-scale systems: high-density power (kW/rack, busbar, PDU), liquid cooling (rear-door, direct liquid, immersion), high-speed networking infrastructure, and/or physical layer constraints
- Experience with AI/ML frameworks (vllm, sglang) at the systems level — you understand what they demand from the hardware and where bottlenecks actually live
- Familiarity with AI server form factors: HGX, OAC, OAM, UBB, open rack standards, and the tradeoffs between them

- Knowledge of Redfish, IPMI and server remote management protocols, and experience with firmware updates

- Exposure to hyperscaler or cloud infrastructure design — understanding how GPU capacity is provisioned, allocated, and operated at scale

- Understanding of AI workload patterns: LLM training vs. inference, model/tensor/pipeline parallelism, and their memory and bandwidth implications
- Familiarity with open compute hardware programs or OCP specifications
- Experience of performance optimization based on hardware / software codesign

The Cloudflare Customer Support Team solves complicated problems and answers technical questions via phone, email, chat and social media. Whether it is a Wordpress blogger using our services for free or a global Enterprise business with petabytes of web traffic, we are always eager to assist. We are the eyes and ears of Cloudflare, acting as the real-time voice of the customer to help communicate their needs and real-world use cases back to the rest of the company - for better service and future product development.
What You'll Do
Do you love solving complex technical issues and interacting with people? Are you passionate about providing premium-level support to customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking an experienced Network Security Engineer to join our team and support our largest and most technically sophisticated customers in resolving technical problems, threats or attacks on their infrastructure at OSI Layers 3, 4, and 7. This will span the range of Cloudflare products from Magic Transit Infrastructure Protection, Argo Smart Routing, DDoS mitigation and Network Firewall, to using the Web Application firewall (WAF), Spectrum and Rate Limiting to help customers.
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor for our enterprise customers, responding to and resolving inquiries and incidents related to network security and performance, while delivering timely, high-quality and personalized assistance.
- Work directly with customers to diagnose, troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues involving DDoS mitigation, firewall rules, SSL/TLS, network confirmation, and other security configurations.
- Create and maintain knowledge base articles, technical guides, and troubleshooting documentation for internal and customer use.
- Compare traffic signatures and attributes including IP addresses, cookie variations, HTTP headers, and JavaScript footprints to determine what is good traffic and what is malicious
- DDoS mitigation for OSI layers 3,4, & 7: advise customers on how to filter malicious traffic using Cloudflare tools like Magic Transit, Network Firewall, WAF, IP reputation lists, packet inspection, blocklisting, allowlisting, and rate limiting
- Work with Engineering and Product teams to improve products and tools
- Utilize generative AI and automation tools to streamline log analysis, accelerate root-cause analysis during security incidents, and optimize customer response times.

- You have a minimum of 4 years experience working as a Network Security Engineer / Technical Support Engineer / Sr. Support Engineer supporting networking or web security products.
- Exceptional troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers.
- Strong customer service orientation and communication skills
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
- Strong understanding of network protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/S, and BGP, with a particular focus on anycast routing concepts and implementation, as well as tools such as iptables and looking glass.
- Proven experience troubleshooting network connectivity issues, BGP routing, and GRE tunnels, and performing packet capture analysis
- Confident with command line and tools, including curl, dig, traceroute, openssl, git
- Experience in a web development and / or hosting environment such as installing and configuring web servers like Apache, Nginx, Caddy and IIS.
- You are competent at writing scripts in Bash, Python, JavaScript or other scripting languages.
- You have worked with PostgreSQL, MySQL, MS SQL, and other database servers.
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
- Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIA GCIH, GCFA, GCFE or equivalent.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

About the Role
Cloudflare’s Billing Engineering team builds and operates the systems responsible for usage metering, aggregation, subscriptions, invoicing, payments, and revenue recognition. These systems power billions in revenue and support millions of customers across Cloudflare’s product portfolio.
We are rebuilding key parts of our billing platform to scale with products including AI, Zero Trust, Workers, Bot Management, and DDoS Protection. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Fintech team, you will design reliable financial infrastructure, lead projects from requirements through production, and help ensure billing remains accurate as Cloudflare grows.
Responsibilities
Build Billing Systems: Design, develop, and operate transactional microservices supporting metering, subscriptions, invoicing, payments, and financial workflows.
Own Projects End to End: Drive initiatives from requirements and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing operation.
Ensure Accuracy and Reliability: Build fault-tolerant systems that safely handle retries, failures, concurrency, and high transaction volumes while preserving financial correctness.
Maintain Operational Excellence: Monitor production services, investigate billing issues, improve observability, and address the underlying causes of recurring incidents.
Shape Technical Direction: Participate in architecture reviews, make pragmatic technical trade-offs, and help improve engineering standards across the billing platform.
Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work with Product, Finance, Accounting, Support, and other engineering teams to turn complex business requirements into maintainable solutions.

- Five or more years of professional software engineering experience, or equivalent practical experience.
- Experience building and operating distributed systems or backend services in production.
- Proficiency in Go or another modern programming language, with an interest in working extensively with Go.
- Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, service security, and API standards such as OpenAPI, OAuth, or JWT.
- Working knowledge of SQL, data modeling, and relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
- Experience designing secure, highly available microservices in Linux or Unix environments.
- Familiarity with event-driven architectures and asynchronous processing.
- Strong troubleshooting, communication, and project ownership skills.
Bonus Points
- Experience with billing, payments, subscriptions, usage metering, invoicing, financial ledgers, or revenue recognition.
- Experience with technologies such as PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, Kubernetes, Docker, or Temporal.
- Familiarity with reconciliation, idempotency, auditability, and financial data integrity.
- Experience leading technically complex projects across multiple teams.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: Bengaluru/Mumbai/New Delhi
About the Role
As a Principal Solutions Architect, you'll be a trusted advisor to Cloudflare's most strategic enterprise customers across the Asia Pacific region. You will work at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and executive influence, helping organisations in industries such as financial services, government, and telecommunications navigate complex digital transformation journeys using Cloudflare's platform.
You'll speak the "customer language", understand the CxO mindset, and influence technology decisions at the intersection of risk, resilience, and innovation. Whether it's advising a CISO on a Zero Trust security strategy, helping a CIO rationalise their network architecture, or working with engineering leadership on edge-native application modernisation, you'll help our most important customers reimagine how the Internet works for them and position Cloudflare as the foundational platform for that future.
You'll be embedded in account planning with our sales and solutions engineering teams, operating proactively across the full customer lifecycle; from early strategic discovery through to long-term platform adoption and expansion. As a Principal Solutions Architect, you'll also play a significant role in raising the architectural capability of the broader Solutions Engineering organisation across APAC.
What You’ll Do
- Own long-term executive relationships across Cloudflare's most strategic APAC accounts; engaging CIOs, CTOs, and CISOs on their multi-year technology agendas and positioning Cloudflare as a foundational platform, not a point solution.
- Design and facilitate executive vision-setting and architecture workshops that produce tangible outcomes: multi-year roadmaps, reference architectures, and business cases co-developed with customers' enterprise architects and engineering leadership.
- Translate industry trends like Zero Trust, Digital Sovereignty, AI workload security, cloud-to-edge migration into actionable architectural strategies tailored to each customer's business context and regulatory environment.
- Guide clients across the full engagement lifecycle; from strategic discovery and architecture design through proof of concept, value realisation, and expansion planning while proactively partnering with the Sales and Solutions Engineering team to surface architectural opportunities before deals are formally scoped.
- Elevate the architectural capability of the broader APAC Solutions Engineering team by developing reusable workshop frameworks, reference architectures, and best practices that others can apply independently; and by mentoring Solutions Engineers in senior stakeholder engagement.
- Represent Cloudflare externally at industry events, executive roundtables, and sector forums as a credible peer to enterprise architects and technology leaders; produce content: white papers, architectural guidance that establishes Cloudflare's voice on key transformation themes across the region.
What Success Looks Like
- In your first 6 months:
- You've established trusted advisor relationships with senior technical and business stakeholders across 3-5 of Cloudflare's most strategic APAC accounts.
- You've designed and facilitated 2-3 executive vision-setting or architecture workshops that have resulted in documented multi-year roadmap alignment with Cloudflare embedded as a core platform component.
- You've shaped at least one strategic engagement where you've connected Cloudflare's developer and edge compute capabilities to a customer's application modernisation or AI strategy; demonstrating platform breadth beyond security alone.
- You've contributed at least one reusable asset to the APAC SE team; a workshop framework, reference architecture, or architectural playbook that others can apply independently.
What We’re Looking For
- 12+ years of experience in technical presales, enterprise architecture, or IT leadership (e.g., Chief Architect, CTO, CISO).
- A genuine ability to operate at two levels simultaneously: credible in a boardroom conversation about digital strategy, and capable of going deep on architecture design with engineering teams.
- Demonstrated experience leading executive-level workshops, technology strategy sessions, or architectural visioning engagements with tangible business outcomes.
- Strong understanding of transformation priorities relevant to APAC enterprises: Zero Trust architecture, cloud and network modernisation, digital sovereignty and data residency, AI infrastructure, and application performance at scale.
- Experience with modern application architecture patterns (microservices, APIs, event-driven systems, CI/CD, serverless and edge compute).
- A track record of proactively contributing to pipeline and account expansion through architectural influence — not just responding to requests.
- Proven ability to enable and elevate peers: you've built frameworks, run internal enablement, or mentored others at scale.
- Confident, compelling communicator in both executive business settings and technical deep dives and comfortable representing Cloudflare publicly at industry events.
- Bonus: Familiarity with enterprise architecture frameworks (TOGAF), security standards (NIST SP 800-207, ISO 27001), and IT risk management principles relevant to regulated industries.
Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Security, or related field.
- Experience in regulated industries (FSI, Government, Telco) or complex multi-cloud/hybrid environments.
- Hands-on technical curiosity: you stay current across networking, cloud infrastructure, application security, and developer platforms; not because the job requires it, but because you find it genuinely interesting.
- Prior experience in a role that required navigating cultural and linguistic diversity across multiple APAC markets.
What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

- Build and curate high-quality, well-modeled, and richly contextual datasets that power internal products, predictive analytics, and LLM-enabled features at company scale.
- Develop a deep understanding of the company’s data ecosystem — including source systems, tooling, and data flows — and collaborate closely with the data and system engineers in Austin, Lisbon, and London to improve data ingestion, quality, and governance.
- Lead by example through design reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship, helping raise the technical bar, data engineering practices, and AI implementation standards across the organization.

- 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, or related roles, building and operating production data systems.

As an Engineering Manager on the CNI team you will hire, mentor, and coach a distributed team of Software Engineers. You will play a key role in developing the team and shaping its culture and technical vision. You will work closely with Product Managers and other Engineering leaders to communicate the vision, prioritize the team's roadmap, and achieve cross-functional objectives. You are a growth-oriented individual who enjoys being outside of your comfort zone. You are comfortable in a fast-paced but sensible work environment. You value curiosity and empathy and lead with these values.
Responsibilities
- Hiring and developing a high-performing team and supporting individual growth.

- Collaborate with internal teams on cross-functional network projects, contributing to design documentation, SOPs, and knowledge base articles that outlast any individual contributor.

Cloudflare operates one of the largest and most interconnected anycast networks on the Internet. On the Addressing team, you will architect, program, and maintain core software services that enable large corporate networks to be protected by Cloudflare. Recent projects range from IP conservation efforts, supporting use cases for Policy driven IP address assignment, designing traffic engineering tools that improve the quality of service for billions of users around the world, and building customer APIs to control BGP dynamically.

You will work closely with other engineers to understand their needs and create scalable platforms to be used across the company.

- You have a solid understanding of TCP/IP and basic networking in general
- You have a basic understanding of the HTTP/S/TLS stack
- You have a working knowledge of SQL and relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL
- You have experience building and operating distributed systems

- Experience working with Rust

The team builds the APIs and control-plane systems used by some of the world's largest platforms. About the Role
The Cloudflare Hyperdrive team builds the technology that makes regional databases feel like they are global. Hyperdrive is a core piece of the Cloudflare Developer Platform that accelerates database queries from Cloudflare Workers by pooling connections and caching data at the edge. By eliminating the massive latency overhead of TCP, TLS, and database-specific handshakes, Hyperdrive allows developers to use the databases they already know and love—like PostgreSQL and MySQL—without the "cold start" performance penalties typically associated with serverless environments.
Responsibilities
Hyperdrive is integrated directly into the Cloudflare global network and features:
- Global Connection Pooling: Maintains "warm" connections to origin databases across the globe, reducing connection times by up to 90%.
- Intelligent Query Caching: Automatically caches frequently run read queries as close to the user as possible.
- Protocol-Aware Proxying: Features custom-built implementations of database wire protocols (PostgreSQL and MySQL) to parse and optimize traffic in real-time.
- Seamless Integration: Works with existing ORMs and drivers, providing a simple connection string that "just works" for developers.
- The team is geographically distributed across North America.
- You will own your code from inception to release, delivering solutions at all layers of the software stack to empower Cloudflare customers. On any given day, you might write a design document that outlines how you plan to solve a specific problem, or fix a bug in how our user experience renders. You can expect to interact with a variety of languages and technologies including, but not limited to Rust, Go, C++, Typescript.

- You have 5+ years of professional experience with Rust, Go, or C++. You understand how to write code that respects CPU and memory constraints.
- You are comfortable with the Linux networking stack. You know your way around TCP/IP, TLS, and WebSockets.
- You don’t just use databases; you understand how they work. You’re familiar with connection lifecycles, transaction states, and wire protocols.
- You enjoy the challenge of debugging complex, distributed systems and building for "five nines" reliability.

- Experience with PgBouncer, ProxySQL, or custom database middleware.

About the Role
Cloudflare's Developer Platform powers stateful, data-intensive applications across our network. We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work across the database stack, from query planning and execution to transaction processing and durable storage.
You'll make decisions that shape the consistency, durability, and latency guarantees that customer applications rely on.
Correctness under concurrency and failure is central to the role. You'll define and implement how queries read and modify data, how concurrent transactions become visible, and how durable state is recovered. You'll validate these systems using deterministic simulation, workload testing, and evidence from production.
Responsibilities
- Improve query planning and execution, including index selection, row reads and writes, and performance as data volumes and access patterns change.
- Build transaction and storage paths that make writes durable and reads consistent. Define when changes become visible, how commits survive failure, and how recovery restores a correct view of the data.
- Design deterministic simulations that make rare event orderings and failures reproducible.
- Plan stateful upgrades that cannot be reversed by rolling back software. Carry them through staged rollout, failover, and recovery without putting existing data at risk.
- Participate in the service's on-call rotation and incident response.
- Own major changes from design through production. Coordinate implementation across teams when a change spans multiple parts of the service, and help trace failures across those parts.
- Mentor other engineers through design reviews, debugging, and incident analysis involving concurrency, durability, and recovery.
Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience
- You have owned a database, storage engine, transaction system, or similarly correctness-sensitive stateful system from architecture through production. You can make architecture and implementation decisions when requirements or system boundaries are incomplete.
- You understand how query execution, indexing, transaction processing, and durable state shape what developers and operators observe.
- You understand how concurrency control, isolation, replication, and snapshots shape consistency, durability, and recovery. You can apply those concepts when operations arrive out of order, components fail independently, or the network partitions.
- You write and debug concurrent production software in Rust, Go, C++, or another systems language. You can trace failures across process, network, and durable-state boundaries.
- You have operated stateful systems through rollouts, scaling events, incidents, and recovery. You know the difference between transient unavailability and incomplete or incorrect recovery, and when a system is safe to return to service.
- You have led investigations where failures crossed systems owned by several teams.
Bonus Points
- You've worked on the internals of PostgreSQL, MySQL, Amazon Aurora, or another relational database and can trace a SQL operation from planning through commit.
- Your work on transaction processing or concurrency control has included defining snapshot visibility and recovery behavior.
- You've profiled database workloads and traced performance bottlenecks from query execution through durable storage.
- You've used deterministic simulation or another systematic method to uncover distributed-systems bugs that conventional tests missed.

About the Role
R2 is Cloudflare's object storage platform, offering developers durable, reliable storage with zero egress fees that integrates seamlessly with Cloudflare's global network and Developer Platform. The R2 Gateway team owns the request-facing layer of R2 — the S3-compatible API gateway that every object put, get, list, and delete flows through. When a customer or application talks to R2, they talk to the systems we build and operate.
R2 is growing rapidly, and the gateway must evolve to keep pace. The team is responsible for the API surface that handles authentication, request routing, rate limiting, and coordination between clients and R2's storage and metadata layers — all while maintaining strict compatibility with the S3 API and delivering low-latency, highly available access at global scale.
You'll be joining a team that operates at the intersection of large-scale distributed systems, storage infrastructure, and edge computing — building request-path systems that need to be correct, fast, and reliable on every single call.
Responsibilities
- Design, implement, and operate the S3-compatible API gateway that serves every R2 operation, ensuring correctness, low latency, and compatibility with the S3 API surface.
- Build and operate production services on Cloudflare Workers and Kubernetes that handle high-throughput request traffic with strong availability and durability guarantees.
- Own the request path end to end — authentication, authorization, routing, rate limiting, and error handling — and the interfaces between the gateway and R2's storage and metadata layers.
- Own projects end to end: from design docs through implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring.

- Experience designing or scaling distributed systems where latency, throughput, availability, and correctness all matter.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.
At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.
Available Locations: Lisbon, or London (Hybrid)
About the Department
Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.
About the Team
We build the products that enable the next era of the Internet: making domains Readable, Discoverable, and Callable for autonomous AI agents.
Here at Cloudflare, agentic discovery is a core part of our vision for the Agentic Internet. As AI agents change how humans and machines find, evaluate, and act on information, businesses need tools to control how they are represented and reached. We build capabilities that enable website owners to prepare their sites for agent interaction, test and observe how agents read their content, establish open interaction standards (like WebMCP and MCP), and create entirely new channels to reach agentic audiences.
We are a cross functional group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.
About the Role
We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Agentic Discovery team to build the core systems, protocols, and customer-facing tools powering agent-web interactions.
In this role, you will design and ship scalable software across edge infrastructure, data pipelines, protocol layers, and developer tooling. You will work on cutting-edge standards like WebMCP, MCP, AEO, and agent-native controls that enable content owners to manage how autonomous AI agents find, parse, and safely execute tasks on their digital properties.
What you'll do
- Design and ship production-ready services that enable customers to evaluate, test, observe, and measure how AI agents read, represent, and interact with their websites and applications.
- Build and maintain support for emerging agent protocols and integrations (MCP, MCP Apps, UCP, MPP, WebMCP).
- Implement fine-grained content controls (access management, licensing, auditing) and agent-native audience/business models (attribution, monetization, and analytics).
- Write clean, secure, well-tested code, advocate for end-user privacy, and help maintain high system reliability, performance, and documentation.
- Partner with software engineers, researchers, product managers, design engineers, and cross-Cloudflare stakeholders to take capabilities from concept to production.
Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience
- Strong software engineering and distributed systems fundamentals.
- Experience building and operating reliable, high-throughput production services.
- Solid understanding of HTTP, APIs, proxies, caching, web security, and web performance.
- Hands-on experience or deep interest in AI agents, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or agent harnesses.
- Ability to rapidly prototype, evaluate architectural trade-offs, and ship solutions in a fast-moving, emerging technical domain.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Bonus Points
- Fluency in Rust (with a big plus for experience in async Rust) or TypeScript/JavaScript edge runtimes (e.g., Cloudflare Workers).
- Hands-on experience with search, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), web crawling, or RAG platform engineering.
- Open-source contributions to agent frameworks, protocols, web standards, browser engines, or distributed systems projects.
- Past experience contributing to a major web framework, proxy, CDN infrastructure, or bare-metal backend cloud provider.
- Proven track record of debugging and resolving network-level and application-level performance bottlenecks.
- Understanding of cryptographic concepts (public-key encryption, digital signatures, hash functions) or privacy-preserving web protocols.
Compensation
Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.
● For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €54,000 - €75,000.
-
The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements.
Equity
This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.
What Makes Cloudflare Special?
We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.
Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.
Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.
1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.
Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Our team at Cloudflare operates under a "Run What You Build" model. This means we are responsible for the health of our systems and actively participate in our team's on-call rotation as part of our operational duties.

- Systems-level programming experience in Rust, Go, C, or C++.
- Understanding of IP networking fundamentals: BGP, Layer 3 routing, and how physical and virtual interconnect technologies work (cross-connects, VLANs, overlay tunnels).
- Experience building, deploying, and debugging distributed systems.
- Experience participating in an on-call rotation for services with direct customer impact.
- Willingness to adopt and integrate AI tools and systems into your workflow.
- Strong collaboration and communication skills.
Bonus Points
- Hands-on experience with BGP configuration, route policy, or peering operations.
- Experience building provisioning or automation systems for network infrastructure.
- Familiarity with network inventory and IPAM systems (e.g., NetBox).
- Experience with cloud provider networking (AWS Direct Connect, GCP Partner Interconnect, Azure ExpressRoute).
- Knowledge of GRE, VXLAN, or other overlay/tunnel technologies.
- Experience with Kubernetes-based service deployments and CI/CD pipelines.
- Experience with telemetry/observability platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, ClickHouse, Elasticsearch).

The Egress team was formed to own a very important aspect of Cloudflare's network-as-a-service: Egress connectivity for our vast portfolio of products.
As a member of the Egress team, you will be a key technical contributor to a cutting edge network software infrastructure used by a growing number of Cloudflare products to connect to any destination from Cloudflare's network. Among the products powered by this technology is WARP, our Zero Trust platform, and Cloudflare's egress proxy for the iCloud Private Relay product.
You will work closely with various Engineering teams to translate their requirements into new capabilities on the platform. Likewise you will partner with Network Engineering and SRE to ensure that the technology makes the best use of Cloudflare's world-class edge network.

- Make daily progress on assigned engineering tasks, such as designing systems, writing specs, writing and pushing code via git, writing release plans for complex changes, rolling out production releases and working with other teams to coordinate system actions
- Participate in daily and ad-hoc team meetings to share progress and collaborate
- Participate in the team’s on-call schedule to ensure uptime of our production systems
- Investigating customer issues that are escalated to the Egress team for triage and resolution
